title: Sales in Construction
description:
Sales Overview

Your Mission



Sales is the bridge between marketing and operations. Your job is to turn qualified opportunities into signed contracts by building trust, guiding prospects through the process, and making sure every deal is set up for success. You aren’t just chasing numbers, you’re shaping the future backlog of the company.



Your Core Duties



Respond quickly to new opportunities and qualify them



Hold initial meetings to understand client needs, scope, and budget



Move qualified projects into estimating with complete information



Deliver proposals on time and present them clearly to the client



Follow up consistently until a decision is made



Track and record all opportunities in Structur CRM with accurate notes



Work with Project Managers to hand off signed projects smoothly



Report weekly results on the Sales Scorecard



What You’re Not Responsible For



Sales does not own project delivery or marketing. You are not responsible for creating leads, managing jobsites, drafting estimates, or handling client selections. Your focus is to qualify, close, and hand off projects with clarity and professionalism.



How You Win in This Role



You win by keeping the pipeline moving. Every opportunity is contacted quickly, every qualified lead is advanced, and every proposal is followed up until it’s closed. You build trust with prospects, remove friction in the buying process, and hand off signed contracts cleanly to operations. When done right, the backlog grows, the company hits revenue targets, and clients enter projects with confidence.



Salary commission based 2-5% project/bi-weekly. Average project is $15,000 .  



In bound leads 15%, cold calling and
ing 85% of our sales. As a General Contractors we are in high demand right now in Commercial Building some of the contracts are $150.000+ .



Only with experience 2+ years in Construction Residential / Commercial, or Home Service Businesses.

title: Marketing Operations Executor — US Healthcare Company (Remote) — 30-Day Full-Time Build, Then Part-Time
description:
Access Plus Health is a US healthcare compliance company founded by a Harvard-trained, board-certified physician. We are hiring a remote marketing executor for a 30-day full-time build phase, converting to part-time (20–25 hrs/week) once the build is done. This role is execution-focused: the founder sets strategy and provides AI-drafted content; you build, launch, manage, and report. You will work heavily with AI tools — we expect it — but you must be able to operate the platforms yourself, live.



What you will do:



1. Manage paid ads on Meta and Google from provided campaign structure: tracking setup (UTMs, pixel/CAPI), budget management, weekly reporting. Ads launch only after tracking is verified.



2.  Run outbound distribution: LinkedIn engagement and scheduling for the founder's account,
 group participation (Phase 1); webinar promotion and referral partner follow-up sequences (Phase 2)



3. Edit, format, and publish SEO articles from AI-assisted drafts (all content physician-reviewed before publishing) — ongoing cadence of 2/week is Phase 2 scope; Phase 1 focuses on the attribution/sequence/reactivation/ads build



4. Build and manage
 campaigns and automations in GoHighLevel from provided sequence specs (new-lead follow-up, reactivation, newsletter)



5. Maintain CRM hygiene and produce a weekly one-page report: leads, cost per lead,
 metrics, pipeline contribution





Requirements: 

- 5+ years marketing execution for US clients — you have personally run paid campaigns and built marketing automations at real volume, not coordinated a team that did; 

- hands-on GoHighLevel (or HubSpot/ActiveCampaign + fast GHL ramp); 

- personally managed Meta/Google campaigns including tracking; 

- excellent written English; fixed daily overlap hours with US Eastern, with same-day response on urgent items during that window (in writing in the offer).



Compensation — two phases, both stated here. This is a remote, globally-sourced role, and the rate below reflects an international market rate rather than a US-based salary.



Phase 1 (Days 1–30, full-time build): $1,200–$2,000/month based on experience — roughly $7–$12/hour. Default length is 30 days; may finish sooner for a strong performer with no reduction in the month's pay. Extends day-for-day at the full Phase 1 rate only if the delay is caused by APH (review turnaround, account access, portal) — not for candidate pace.



Phase 2 (Day 31 onward): part-time at ~20–25 hrs/week, with pay scaled proportionally from the Phase 1 rate and a small fixed daily overlap with US Eastern hours so urgent items still get a same-day response, both stated in writing.



Bonus: $150–$300/month on qualified-lead targets, carried through both phases and becoming a larger share of total pay once base hours drop.



Day-30 fork (APH's option, not a promise): if performance clearly warrants it, APH may keep this hire full-time at the Phase 1 rate with expanded scope folded in (CRM ownership, proposal support, follow-up sequencing) instead of converting to part-time.



Paid live working session before hire. 



To apply: resume, 2 writing samples, 1 campaign you personally managed (with numbers), and the word "COMPLIANT" first in your application

title: Sales Assistant
description:
About Us



Graham Landscape & Design is an established landscape design, construction, and maintenance company serving the Eugene, Oregon area.



We're looking for an experienced, highly organized Sales Operations Coordinator to support our sales department and help keep our customers, projects, and internal processes running smoothly.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who enjoys working with technology, solving problems, communicating with customers, and taking ownership of their work.



What You'll Do

- CRM & Sales Support: Maintain customer records, sales opportunities, follow-up tasks, and pipeline information in Aspire CRM.

- Customer Communication: Assist with appointment scheduling, customer follow-ups, and
 correspondence.

- Estimating Support: Prepare proposals, update service items, research materials, and assist with estimating documentation.

- Reporting & Analysis: Prepare sales reports, track KPIs, review production data, and identify discrepancies.

- Project Coordination: Coordinate information between sales, design, and operations to ensure smooth project handoffs.

- Administrative Support: Research products, prepare permit documentation, organize subcontractor information, and maintain internal processes.

- Ad Hoc Tasks: Cold calling during off-season and any other support the Sales Manager needs.



What We're Looking For

Required:

- At least 5 years of experience in sales support, project coordination, or administrative operations.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets.

- Experience working with CRM software or similar business management systems.

- Exceptional organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.

- Reliable computer, internet connection, and a professional remote work environment.



Preferred:

- Experience supporting a U.S.-based company.

- Familiarity with construction, landscaping, property services, or similar industries.

- Experience with estimating, job costing, or project management software.

- Experience with Aspire CRM.



Who Will Succeed Here?

You're someone who notices when information is missing, catches mistakes before they cause problems, and takes initiative rather than waiting to be told what to do.

You're comfortable juggling multiple priorities, asking questions when necessary, and following established processes.

You enjoy supporting a team and take pride in being someone others can depend on.



Why Join Graham?

Long-term, full-time opportunity with an established U.S. company.

Direct collaboration with the Sales Manager.

Opportunities to develop technical skills in CRM management, estimating, and construction operations.

Structured processes, clear responsibilities, and opportunities for professional growth.

A team that values Absolute Accountability, Persistent Passion, and Service Beyond Expectation.



How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a brief audio introduction outlining your relevant experience. Send it to 
 with the subject line: Sales Assistant - [Your Name]



In your application, please include:

- Which CRM or project management systems have you used?

- Describe an example of a spreadsheet or reporting task you've completed.

- What experience do you have supporting U.S.-based customers or businesses?



We are looking for someone who wants to become a dependable, long-term member of our team—not simply complete assigned tasks.

Work Hours: 

Monday to Friday, 8-hour shift with a 30-minute unpaid break

Selected candidates will be assigned to one of two shifts:

7:00 AM to 3:30 PM Pacific Time

8:00 AM to 4:30 PM Pacific Time





Job Overview: 



We are seeking a sharp, organized, and highly detail-oriented E-Commerce Customer Service & Order Processing Specialist to manage customer inquiries, order processing, vendor coordination, and fulfillment activities for a high-volume e-commerce operation. The ideal candidate has prior e-commerce experience, is highly proficient with computer-based systems, and can quickly navigate multiple platforms while managing a busy inbox and a large volume of orders. This role requires strong written and spoken English, excellent follow-up skills, and the ability to independently manage tasks, follow established workflows, and proactively resolve issues in a fast-paced environment.



Key Responsibilities:



Manage high-volume customer service and order-related
 inboxes.

Respond promptly and professionally to customer inquiries regarding order status, product availability, lead times, shipping, and tracking.

Process and manage customer orders through Shopify.

Prepare and send purchase orders to vendors.

Check vendor portals to verify product availability, inventory, and lead times.

Follow up with vendors regarding outstanding orders, product availability, and expected fulfillment dates.

Contact vendors by phone when
 follow-ups do not receive a timely response.

Upload and update tracking numbers and shipping information.

Monitor drop-ship orders from order placement through fulfillment to ensure orders are progressing as expected.

Provide customers with accurate and timely updates regarding order status, shipping, availability, and delays.

Help manage approximately 150 orders and 200–300 customer
s per day across the team.

Update and maintain CSV files, spreadsheets, and other operational records as needed.

Perform general e-commerce administrative and order-processing tasks.

Identify unusual or complex order and customer issues and escalate them to the appropriate internal team member when necessary.

Follow established SOPs and workflows while taking ownership of assigned tasks and ensuring issues are followed through to resolution.



Required Skills & Qualifications:

title: Digital Asset Management Specialist |
description:
# Digital Asset Management Specialist | Project-Based, Remote



**Company:** Meld & Motion



**Location:** Philippines (Remote)



**Employment Type:** Project-Based / Contract, with potential ongoing work



**Compensation:** Please submit your project rate or estimated cost.



### About the Project



Meld & Motion is a U.S.-based creative agency specializing in commercial video production and digital content.



We are looking for an experienced **Digital Asset Management (DAM) Specialist** to help design, build, and implement a professional asset management system for one of our large corporate clients.



Our client is a nationwide organization with an internal IT department. The system will be built in collaboration with their IT team and must be scalable, secure, easy to navigate, and simple for administrative staff to maintain.



We are not looking for someone to simply organize files in Google Drive. We need someone who understands how to build a functional DAM infrastructure.



### Key Responsibilities



- Evaluate and recommend an appropriate DAM platform and hosting solution.

- Work with the client's IT department to establish technical requirements and system architecture.

- Configure and implement the selected DAM platform.

- Develop a logical folder structure, metadata standards, and tagging system.

- Implement advanced search and asset retrieval capabilities.

- Establish user roles, permissions, and secure access controls.

- Create workflows for uploading, categorizing, and retrieving digital assets.

- Test the system with a pilot collection before full deployment.

- Document the system and provide training for our virtual assistants, who will manage ongoing tagging and maintenance.



### Required Qualifications



- Previous experience implementing digital asset management systems.

- Familiarity with DAM platforms, cloud storage, and file management infrastructure.

- Experience managing large video and photography libraries.

- Understanding of metadata, taxonomy, tagging, and search functionality.

- Knowledge of user permissions and secure file access.

- Ability to communicate technical requirements with a corporate IT team.

- Strong English communication and documentation skills.

- Ability to work independently and meet project milestones.



### Preferred Experience



- Experience with Iconik, ResourceSpace, or similar DAM platforms.

- Experience with Backblaze B2, AWS S3, or comparable cloud storage.

- Familiarity with video production workflows and common media formats.

- Previous experience building scalable asset libraries for businesses or creative agencies.



### Project Structure



This is initially a **fixed-scope implementation project**, with the possibility of ongoing technical maintenance and support.



Our goal is to build a reliable system that can be maintained by trained virtual assistants without requiring constant developer intervention.



We have an existing team available to assist with asset organization, tagging, and administrative tasks.



### How to Apply



Please provide the following information:



1. **Previous Experience:** Describe at least one DAM system you have personally implemented.

2. **Platforms:** Which DAM platforms have you worked with?

3. **Technical Approach:** How would you approach building a DAM system for a corporate organization that already has an internal IT department?

4. **Portfolio:** Share examples, screenshots, or descriptions of similar projects.

5. **Compensation:** Provide your hourly rate, estimated project fee, or proposed paid discovery fee.

6. **Availability:** When can you begin, and what is your estimated implementation timeline?



**Important:** Please begin your application with the words **"DAM SYSTEM BUILDER"** so we know you have read the full description.



We are seeking someone interested in building a long-term professional relationship as we expand our digital asset management services.



**Meld & Motion**



Commercial Video Production & Creative Solutions

title: Technical Onboarding & Automation Specialist (GoHighLevel / Zapier) – Night Shift, Client-Facing
description:
⏰ READ THIS FIRST



This role requires live availability 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Central Time, Monday–Friday. That's 10:00 PM – 6:00 AM Philippine Time from March to early November, and 11:00 PM – 7:00 AM Philippine Time from early November to March, when the US switches to standard time.



Compensation: $1,000 USD/month.



If the hours or pay don't work for you, this isn't the right fit, and we respect your time too much to waste it.



ABOUT CLINIC GROWTH ACCELERATOR



We're a US-based performance marketing agency serving cash-pay healthcare clinics: chiropractic, neurofeedback, functional medicine, and similar practices. We've served 350+ clinics across 26 US states with Meta advertising, landing pages, and marketing automation. Our mission is to help healthcare providers reach more of the people who need them.



We run a systems-first operation with clear SOPs, scorecards, and real accountability. You will never have to guess what's expected of you.



THE ROLE

You own the technical side of our client accounts, from "contract signed" to "campaigns ready to launch," and you keep everything running after launch.



You'll be the friendly, patient expert who gets on Zoom with clinic owners (most are not tech-savvy) and walks them through granting Meta Business Manager access, white-glove style. Then you'll build their CRM, calendars, automations, and data connections so their marketing runs smoothly.



You'll manage the tech for a portfolio of 40–50 active clients and run new-client onboarding calls every week. Expect about 30% live client calls, 60% building systems, and 10% troubleshooting.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Lead white-glove Zoom onboarding calls with new clients to set up Meta Business Manager, ad account, page, and pixel/dataset permissions, explained patiently and without jargon

- Build and configure GoHighLevel sub-accounts from our snapshots: workflows, pipelines, calendars, phone/email setup, and custom fields

- Own all Zapier automations (and n8n as you grow): lead routing, booking flows, CRM syncs, and notifications

- Own client data: set up and maintain GHL to Google Sheets syncs and keep data accurate and reconciled across systems

- Verify every new account against our launch-readiness checklist before handing it to the account team

- Own the tech request queue for your 40–50 clients: broken workflows, calendar issues, and integration failures

 -Keep our onboarding SOPs current as Meta and GHL change



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (HOW YOU'RE MEASURED)



- New clients fully onboarded and launch-ready within 3 business days of contract signing

- 100% of accounts pass the launch-readiness checklist on first review

- Tech requests acknowledged within [2] business hours and resolved within [1] business days

- Client data sheets accurate and reconciled weekly

- Clients leave onboarding calls feeling taken care of (tracked by post-call rating)



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- Fluent, confident spoken English. You'll be on camera with US business owners every week.

- 1+ year of hands-on GoHighLevel experience (sub-account builds, workflows, calendars)

- Solid Zapier experience. n8n is a major plus, and we'll train the right person.

- Working knowledge of Meta Business Manager: Business Portfolios, ad accounts, pages, pixels/datasets, and partner access

- Strong Google Sheets skills and disciplined data hygiene

- A calm, patient manner with non-technical people. You make clients feel looked after, never talked down to.

- Process-driven: you follow checklists, update SOPs, and document as you go

- Comfortable working a consistent night shift

- Fast, reliable internet (minimum 25 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload), a quality webcam and mic, and a quiet workspace

- Backup power (UPS, inverter, or generator) and backup internet (second ISP, LTE, or pocket WiFi) so brownouts and outages don't interrupt client calls



NICE TO HAVE



- Marketing agency experience serving US small businesses

- Familiarity with healthcare or clinics

- API-level troubleshooting (webhooks, JSON, HTTP requests in n8n)

- Twilio/LC Phone, Stripe, or Google Workspace admin experience



HOW WE WORK



These values aren't posters on a wall. We hire, review, and promote by them.



Take Initiative. If you see a problem, you own it. You don't wait for permission.

Solutions Not Problems. Before escalating, you bring 1 problem, 3 possible solutions, and 1 recommendation.

1% Better Every Day. Every process and every person keeps improving.

Follow through on promises. If you say you'll do it, it gets done.



COMPENSATION & STRUCTURE



- Independent contractor, full-time (~40 hrs/week), paid monthly in USD

- $1,000/month

- 60-day ramp period with reduced targets and full training from the person who built our current system



HOW TO APPLY

title: Graphic Design Manager (leadership experience required)
description:
Starbond is looking for an experienced Graphic Design Manager to lead our creative team, strengthen our brand standards, and improve the quality and efficiency of our design output across digital marketing, print, packaging, and e-commerce.



This is a hands-on management role requiring at least 10 years of professional graphic design experience and at least 5 years of progressively responsible creative leadership experience, including direct management of designers or creative teams. Hands-on experience creating Amazon A+ Content is required.



The successful candidate must be able to establish creative direction, develop clear visual standards, manage team performance, and personally produce high-quality design work. You should understand how visual communication supports marketing goals and know how to use AI and modern creative tools to improve production efficiency while maintaining strong creative judgment.



Mandatory Qualifications



To be considered, applicants must meet all of the following:

At least 10 years of professional graphic design experience, with substantial work supporting marketing, e-commerce, retail, or consumer-product brands.

At least 5 years of progressively responsible creative leadership experience, demonstrating increasing responsibility for team management, creative direction, and delivery.

Direct people-management experience, including assigning work, reviewing output, coaching designers, setting performance expectations, and addressing performance issues.

Hands-on experience designing Amazon A+ Content, supported by portfolio examples.

Demonstrated experience developing, implementing, and enforcing brand guidelines.

Advanced proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign.

Strong command of typography, layout, composition, color theory, hierarchy, spacing, and visual storytelling.

A portfolio demonstrating digital, print, packaging, and e-commerce design, including work produced under the applicant’s creative direction.



Individual contributor experience or project coordination alone does not satisfy the leadership requirement. Applicants must clearly demonstrate responsibility for managing people and improving team performance.



Key Responsibilities



Creative Direction and Brand Management

Own Starbond’s visual direction across digital marketing, print, packaging, social media, and e-commerce.

Develop, document, maintain, and enforce comprehensive brand guidelines and visual standards.

Translate business and marketing objectives into clear, effective creative concepts.

Establish consistent standards for typography, layout, color, hierarchy, composition, spacing, and visual storytelling.

Identify weaknesses or inconsistencies in creative work and provide specific direction for improvement.

Develop foundational designs, templates, and reusable creative systems that the team can adapt efficiently across campaigns and platforms.

Explain design decisions in terms of audience, communication goals, brand consistency, and business impact.



People and Creative Team Management

Directly manage designers and oversee freelancers and other creative contributors.

Define responsibilities, assign projects, and balance workloads based on business priorities, capacity, and deadlines.

Set clear expectations for design quality, turnaround time, communication, file organization, and brand consistency.

Review creative work and provide specific, constructive, actionable feedback.

Coach team members to improve their design judgment, technical skills, and production efficiency.

Conduct regular performance discussions, identify development needs, and address recurring quality or productivity issues.

Take accountability for the team’s output, delivery commitments, and adherence to creative standards.

Collaborate with marketing leadership and other departments to clarify briefs, resolve competing priorities, and keep projects moving.



Hands-On Design and Production

Personally develop key campaign concepts, high-priority assets, templates, and foundational designs.

Create and oversee production of:

Amazon A+ Content, listing images, product infographics, and storefront graphics

Website and landing-page graphics

 marketing visuals

Social media content and advertisements

Brochures, flyers, posters, catalogs, and product inserts

Product packaging and labels

Campaign and promotional materials

Design Amazon A+ Content that communicates product benefits clearly and supports informed purchasing decisions.

Prepare accurate, production-ready files for digital and print use.

Review packaging dielines, proofs, dimensions, bleeds, color modes, resolution, and other production specifications.

Maintain organized, editable source files and clear asset-versioning practices.



Workflow, AI, and Production Efficiency

Establish workflows that improve creative quality, turnaround time, and team capacity.

Clarify briefs and approval requirements to reduce avoidable revisions.

Introduce practical uses of AI-assisted tools, automation, templates, and reusable design systems.

Guide the team in using AI for concept exploration, image creation and editing, creative variations, and repetitive production tasks.

Maintain accuracy, brand consistency, and original creative judgment when using AI-assisted materials.

Monitor quality, timeliness, revision rates, and the usefulness of completed output.

Identify production bottlenecks and implement practical improvements.

Evaluate new tools and creative-production practices for their value to the team.



Portfolio and Application Requirements:

Applicants must submit an updated resume and portfolio. Applications must clearly demonstrate both design expertise and management experience.

title: Content Producer & Social Media Creative Lead — Women’s Jewelry Brand (KAEN)
description:
About KAEN



KAEN is a new US-based women’s jewelry brand focused on modern, elevated, and accessible jewelry.



We’re building a visually driven e-commerce brand where content is a major part of our growth strategy.



We’re looking for a creative, resourceful Content Producer who can take ownership of our Instagram content and help develop a consistent pipeline of high-quality video and photo content for organic social media and paid advertising.



About the Role



We are not looking for someone who simply schedules Instagram posts or makes generic Canva graphics.



We want someone who understands jewelry, fashion, visual storytelling, and what makes people stop scrolling.



You’ll be responsible for developing content ideas, organizing production, creating content yourself when possible, and coordinating with creators, videographers, and editors when needed.



Our goal is to build a repeatable content production system that consistently produces beautiful, engaging content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and Meta advertising.



Key Responsibilities



1. Creative Research & Content Strategy



* Research successful jewelry, fashion, and lifestyle brands.

* Identify emerging Instagram and TikTok content trends.

* Develop creative concepts for organic posts and paid ads.

* Build a library of visual references and inspiration.

* Plan weekly content calendars and production schedules.

* Maintain a consistent, elevated brand aesthetic.



2. Content Creation & Filming



* Create short-form jewelry videos, including product close-ups, styling, unboxing, and lifestyle content.

* Film content yourself when appropriate, using jewelry samples provided by the company.

* Coordinate additional creators or models when needed.

* Develop shot lists and clear filming instructions.

* Ensure content looks polished, modern, and visually appealing.

* Produce content suitable for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and Meta ads.



3. Creative Production Management



* Find and coordinate freelance creators, videographers, and editors.

* Brief creators on exactly what to film.

* Manage content deadlines and deliverables.

* Review footage and request revisions.

* Organize raw footage, edited videos, and final assets.

* Maintain a consistent weekly production pipeline.



4. Instagram Content Management



* Manage KAEN’s Instagram content calendar.

* Prepare Reels, carousels, product photography, and captions.

* Schedule and publish approved content.

* Monitor engagement and identify successful content formats.

* Continuously develop new creative ideas.



5. Paid Advertising Creative



* Develop video and static ad concepts for Meta advertising.

* Work with our advertising manager to understand which creatives perform best.

* Produce variations of successful concepts.

* Test different visual approaches, product presentations, and creative hooks.

* Help scale the volume of high-quality advertising content over time.



What We’re Looking For



* Experience creating content for jewelry, fashion, beauty, or lifestyle brands.

* Strong visual taste and understanding of premium e-commerce aesthetics.

* Experience filming short-form videos using an iPhone or camera.

* Understanding of Instagram Reels, TikTok, and Meta advertising.

* Ability to edit videos using CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar software.

* Experience coordinating content creators or freelance editors.

* Strong organizational and project management skills.

* Comfortable using AI tools to improve creative workflows.

* Able to work independently and take ownership of content production.

* Excellent written English and communication skills.



Experience producing content for DTC e-commerce brands is highly preferred.



Creative Direction



We’re building a jewelry brand with a clean, modern, elevated aesthetic.



We prefer:



* Beautiful product close-ups and jewelry details.

* Natural lighting and sophisticated styling.

* Hands, necklines, ears, and lifestyle jewelry shots.

* Short, visually engaging videos.

* Minimal, tasteful editing.

* Content that feels organic rather than overly promotional.



We are not looking for generic dropshipping ads, aggressive sales pitches, or constant talking-head videos.



Initial Goals



During the first month, we’d like to establish a reliable content production workflow and work toward:



* 12–20 Instagram Reels / short-form videos.

* 10–15 static images or carousel assets.

* A consistent Instagram posting schedule.

* A library of creative concepts and references.

* A repeatable process for developing new advertising creatives.



These are initial targets, not rigid quotas. Production volume will depend on available footage, product samples, and any additional creator or editing budget.



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions:



1. Share 3–5 examples of Instagram Reels, TikToks, or advertisements you personally created or produced. Explain your role in each.



2. Have you worked with jewelry, fashion, beauty, or other visually driven e-commerce brands? Please share examples.



3. Are you comfortable filming jewelry content yourself if we ship you physical samples? What filming equipment do you currently have?



4. Have you managed other content creators, videographers, or editors? Describe your experience.



5. Imagine you’re launching a new women’s jewelry brand with limited existing content. How would you build its Instagram content and paid advertising creative pipeline during the first 30 days?



6. What is your hourly rate, and how many hours per week are you available?



Please include a link to your portfolio.



Applications without relevant creative examples will not be considered.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
About Starbond

Starbond is a growing direct-to-consumer brand focused on delivering high-quality products and an excellent customer experience. We are looking for a hands-on Marketing Manager who can turn data, customer insights, and strong execution into profitable growth.



About the Role

The Marketing Manager will own Starbond’s direct-to-consumer growth engine across paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, content, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), social media, conversion optimization, and agency performance. This role requires a strong command of unit economics—including customer lifetime value (LTV), customer acquisition cost (CAC), CAC payback period, gross margin, and contribution margin—and the ability to convert these metrics into sound growth decisions.



You will directly manage marketing agencies across Meta, Google, email, and AEO while leading the internal Marketing team, setting clear performance standards, and giving the CEO timely visibility into results, risks, and recommended actions.



Key Responsibilities



DTC Growth and Customer Acquisition

Develop and lead the DTC acquisition strategy across Meta Ads, Google Ads, Shopify, email, SEO, social media, Amazon alignment, and other relevant channels.

Manage marketing for profitable growth—not revenue or ROAS alone—by incorporating product margin, contribution margin, retention, and customer quality into decisions.

Establish acceptable CAC thresholds by product, customer segment, campaign, and channel, and recommend when to scale, restructure, reduce, or discontinue investment.

Align advertising, creative, landing pages, offers, product positioning, inventory availability, and operational readiness.



LTV, Retention, and Lifecycle Marketing

Maintain a clear and consistent LTV methodology using customer revenue, purchase frequency, retention, gross margin or contribution margin, and cohort data.

Analyze LTV and retention by acquisition source, product, cohort, and customer segment, and use the findings to improve channel and offer decisions.

Lead strategies that improve repeat purchase rate, purchase frequency, average order value, cross-sell, replenishment, retention, and win-back performance.

Oversee email and lifecycle marketing quality, segmentation, deliverability, revenue contribution, and customer communication accuracy.



Paid Advertising and Conversion

Oversee paid media strategy, budget pacing, campaign structure, audience strategy, creative testing, attribution, and landing-page performance.

Establish clear testing, scaling, optimization, and stop-loss rules, and require decisions to be supported by sufficient data and financial context.

Review performance at the channel, campaign, audience, creative, product, and cohort levels.

Partner with the Web Developer on Shopify priorities, site performance, conversion rate optimization, tracking, and quality assurance.



Agency and Vendor Management

Directly manage marketing agencies across Meta, Google, email, and AEO, including scopes of work, deliverables, timelines, communication standards, SLAs, KPIs, reporting, ownership, and escalation procedures.

Use agency scorecards and recurring performance reviews to track KPI attainment, SLA compliance, output quality, timeliness, efficiency, and business results.

Require root-cause analysis and time-bound corrective action plans for missed targets, SLA breaches, quality issues, reporting gaps, or inefficient spend.

Independently validate agency recommendations and recommend contract expansion, renegotiation, reduction, replacement, or termination when appropriate.

Ensure Starbond retains access to and ownership of advertising accounts, data, dashboards, creative files, documentation, and intellectual property.



Content, Creative, and Brand

Maintain an active content and creative pipeline supported by clear briefs, owners, deadlines, QA standards, and success metrics.

Ensure reliable content-production support is available when external resources are required.

Create a structured process for testing creative concepts, hooks, formats, messages, offers, and calls to action.

Protect product positioning and perceived value by avoiding excessive reliance on discounting and ensuring marketing claims are accurate and supportable.

Ensure approved assets are properly named, organized, and stored in company-owned systems.



Team Leadership, Process, and Reporting

Lead the internal Marketing team by setting clear responsibilities, deadlines, quality standards, KPIs, communication expectations, and individual performance targets.

Conduct regular coaching, one-on-ones, performance reviews, and accountability conversations; identify skill gaps and coordinate development or corrective action with HR.

Make timely recommendations regarding training, role clarity, workload changes, reassignment, or other performance actions when standards are not met.

Create and maintain marketing processes, approval flows, reporting definitions, campaign documentation, and quality-control systems.

Maintain a weekly marketing scorecard that distinguishes leading and lagging indicators and explains what changed, why it changed, and what action is required.

Proactively escalate material risks and present concise, financially grounded recommendations to the CEO.



What Success Looks Like



Marketing data, forecasts, campaign reports, creative briefs, and recommendations are accurate, validated, and financially grounded.

Campaigns, agency deliverables, reports, corrective actions, and launches are completed on time, with blockers escalated early.

CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC, MER, ROAS, contribution margin, retention, and cohort performance are consistently defined and used to guide decisions.

Marketing investment produces profitable customer growth, stronger retention, faster learning, higher-quality execution, and stronger brand protection.

The Marketing team and external agencies operate with clear ownership, measurable standards, and consistent accountability.



What We’re Looking For



Proven experience leading DTC or e-commerce marketing across paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, content, and conversion optimization.

Strong working knowledge of CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC, MER, ROAS, contribution margin, retention, cohort analysis, and marketing attribution.

Experience managing Meta Ads, Google Ads, email marketing, SEO, AEO, Shopify, and agency partners.

Demonstrated ability to manage budgets and make channel decisions based on profitability and customer quality.

Experience leading and developing marketing team members, setting KPIs, and managing performance.

Strong analytical judgment with the ability to challenge assumptions, validate agency recommendations, and translate data into clear actions.

Excellent written and verbal communication, with a proactive and concise reporting style.

Highly organized, accountable, and comfortable working in a remote, fast-moving environment.



Tools and Platforms

Google Workspace, ClickUp, Shopify, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, Amazon advertising and marketplace reports, Google Analytics, Looker Studio or Power BI, Klaviyo or a similar lifecycle platform, spreadsheets, and agency reporting systems.



How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter that addresses the following:

Describe a DTC or e-commerce business you helped grow and the results you personally influenced.

Share an example of how you used CAC, LTV, contribution margin, retention, or cohort data to make a marketing decision.

Describe your experience managing marketing agencies and holding them accountable to KPIs and deadlines.

List the advertising, analytics, e-commerce, and lifecycle marketing platforms you have used.



Applications that include specific examples and measurable outcomes will receive priority consideration.

Company: MANNEKIN. Our core offer is Post To Profit, a social media agency program that has helped 640+ businesses grow with content



ABOUT THE ROLE

We're a fast-growing social media agency, and we're hiring a Chief Editor to lead video editing for our clients. You'll edit talking-head content for many agency clients: short-form Reels and Shorts, plus long-form YouTube videos.



This is a lead role, not a "just edit what you're sent" job. We want someone who knows what makes a video hold attention, works fast, and is highly proficient with AI for editing. AI, especially Claude, is central to how we work, and we want an editor who uses it to get far more done in less time. WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Edit talking-head short-form videos (Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok) for multiple agency clients

- Follow each client's style and brand, and keep quality consistent across every client

- Use AI tools, especially Claude, to speed up editing: transcription, captions, silence and filler removal, audio cleanup, research, and more

- Check every video for mistakes (retakes, cut-off words, typos, audio issues) before it's delivered

- Hit deadlines across several clients at once: short-form edits delivered within 24 hours, long-form edits within 48 hours

- Help build and improve our editing process as we grow

- Fill out our EOD (end-of-day) report at the end of every workday



REQUIREMENTS

- Skilled in Adobe Premiere Pro (required)

- Strong short-form and long-form editing experience. You understand retention, hooks, pacing and what keeps people watching.

- Highly proficient with AI for editing. AI is a core part of how you edit, not an add-on. You use Claude and other AI tools every day to edit faster and better, and you can show us exactly how

- At least 6 months of experience editing talking-head content (short-form and long-form)

- Fast, organized and detail-oriented: you can manage multiple clients without things slipping

- Good written English and clear communication

NICE TO HAVE

- After Effects or motion graphics skills

- Experience editing for a content or marketing agency

- Experience leading or training other editors

- Basic thumbnail design skills



WHY JOIN US

- $2,000/month, full-time and long-term

- Real growth opportunities: a lead role that grows as the company grows

- Work on many brands and formats, so your skills keep improving

- Fully remote, Monday–Friday

- 13th-month pay after 12 months with us



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)

Applications that don't follow these steps will not be reviewed.

1. Subject line: Start your subject line with your favorite food, then the role and your name. Format: "[Your favorite food] | Chief Editor | [Your name]"

2. Portfolio: Send links to at least 2 long-form YouTube videos and 3 short-form talking-head videos you edited. Tell us what you did on each one.

3. AI tools: Tell us how you use Claude in your editing, list any other AI tools you use, and explain in 1–2 sentences how each one saves you time. Then walk us through one real edit where AI did a big part of the work.

4. Premiere Pro: Tell us how many years you've used Adobe Premiere Pro.

5. Short video intro: Send a 1–2 minute Loom (or similar) introducing yourself and walking through one of your edits.



We look forward to seeing your work!

title: Short-Form Video Editor — Reels, Shorts, and Social Content (30–180 sec)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

 

We are a real estate company that produces long-form video content across education, investment, faith and land development topics. We need a short-form editor who can take that long-form content and clip it into high-performing short-form videos for Reels, Shorts, and social platforms. Occasionally you will also create variations of existing short-form clips for use as ads.

 

This is a high-volume, ongoing role. If your edits perform, there's consistent work and performance bonuses on top of your per-video rate.

 

---

 

SCOPE

 

Short-form videos between 30 and 180 seconds, repurposed from long-form source content. Up to 25 videos per week, capped at 100 per month. Each video must be fully platform-ready on delivery — no open loops.

 

Primary: Clipping and editing short-form content from long-form recordings

Secondary: Creating ad variations from existing short-form clips

 

---

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR IN EVERY EDIT

 

- Hook mastery — you can identify the strongest moments in a long-form video and know how to open with a visual hook, text hook, and audio hook that stops the scroll in the first 2–3 seconds

- Body retention — the middle holds attention as well as the opening; pacing, pattern interrupts, and visual momentum throughout

- Smooth call to action — the CTA feels like a natural close, not a hard sell bolted on at the end

- Effective audio — music and sound design that reinforces the message and energy without overpowering it; aligned with brand, not exaggerated

- Brand alignment — every clip should feel like it belongs to the same family of content; consistent tone, text style, and visual rhythm

- Platform awareness — you know what works on Reels vs. Shorts and can optimize accordingly without being told

 

---

 

SKILLS REQUIRED

 

- Strong short-form portfolio — share examples that show you can pull compelling clips from long-form source material

- Proven understanding of what makes short-form content perform, not just look good

- Experience creating ad variations from organic short-form content

- Captions, text overlays, and on-screen graphics that complement — not clutter — the video

- Comfortable working at volume with fast turnaround

- Familiar with 
 for review and approval, and Google Drive for final file delivery

 

---

 

WORKFLOW

 

You'll receive long-form source footage and a brief for each batch. Edits are submitted to 
 for review and approval. Once approved, final files are uploaded to a designated Google Drive folder per the instructions provided.

 

---

 

COMPENSATION

 

- Rate: $15 per approved video

- Max volume: 100 videos/month (~25/week)

- Monthly cap: $1,500/month

- Performance bonuses: available for videos that hit strong view, reach, and engagement benchmarks

 

Pay is strictly per approved and delivered video. Only videos that clear the 
 approval process count toward your monthly total. There is no guaranteed floor — you are paid for what you deliver.

 

Videos that consistently perform well are eligible for bonuses. We track what works and reward the edits that drive results. Strong, consistent output over time opens the door to increased volume and rate.

 

---

 

TO APPLY — ANSWER THESE THREE QUESTIONS IN YOUR PROPOSAL

 

1. Walk me through how you identify the best clips inside a long-form video. What are you looking for, and how do you d
 where to start and end a clip?

 

2. Share 2–3 short-form videos you edited that were repurposed from long-form content — and tell us what you were trying to accomplish with each one beyond just making it look good.

 

3. How do you use audio in a short-form video? What's your approach to music selection and sound design for a professional brand that wants energy without feeling overhyped?

title: Etsy & E-Commerce Operations VA – Pinterest, Printify & AI
description:
Etsy | Pinterest | Printify | AI Content



Business: Rooted by Nyah

Employment Type: Part-Time

Hours: 15 hours per week

Pay: $7.5 USD/hour

Work Location: Remote

Position Type: Long-Term Opportunity



About Rooted by Nyah



Rooted by Nyah is a growing creative e-commerce brand focused on AI-generated artwork, digital prints, printable wall art, and related print-on-demand products.



The brand operates across multiple platforms, including Etsy, Pinterest, Printify, and a direct website, with a strong focus on high-quality presentation, cohesive branding, discoverability, and developing products that appeal to specific customer niches.



We are looking for an organized, creative, and proactive E-Commerce Operations & Brand Coordinator who can help strengthen the systems behind the business while supporting the ongoing creation, publication, promotion, and management of products.



This is not a basic data-entry or task-only virtual assistant position.



The ideal candidate will be able to take ownership of recurring processes, help create organized workflows, recognize opportunities for improvement, and help turn finished artwork into properly presented and marketed products.



Position Objective



The primary purpose of this position is to help build and manage a repeatable e-commerce system that moves products through the following process:



Artwork → Quality Review → Product Development → Mockups → Etsy Listing → SEO → Printify → Pinterest → Website → Promotion → Performance Review



The Coordinator will help ensure that products do not simply get created, but are also properly organized, listed, marketed, tracked, and improved over time.



Key Responsibilities

Etsy Shop Management

Create and publish new Etsy listings

Maintain listing templates and repeatable publishing processes

Help maintain a clean, professional, and cohesive storefront

Pinterest Content & Traffic Growth

Responsibilities may include:



Turn existing products and artwork into Pinterest content

Create Pinterest graphics using Canva or similar platforms

Write keyword-focused Pinterest titles and descriptions

Link pins to appropriate Etsy listings or website products

Create multiple pin variations for individual products

Schedule and publish Pinterest content consistently

Maintain organized Pinterest boards

Repurpose existing artwork into new content

Review Pinterest analytics

Identify high-performing pins and topics

Help build and maintain a Pinterest content calendar

Printify & Print-on-Demand Management

Responsibilities may include:



Create new Printify products

Upload and position artwork correctly

Review product mockups

Check variants and product information

Review costs and basic profit margins

Publish products to connected sales channels

Update product descriptions and images

Review existing products for quality and consistency

Research new Printify products that fit the brand

Recommend existing artwork that may translate well into physical products

Assist with seasonal print-on-demand product development

AI Artwork Organization & Quality Control



Help organize and prepare AI-generated artwork for commercial use.



Responsibilities may include:



Review artwork for visible AI artifacts or inconsistencies

Identify files requiring edits before publication

Organize artwork into collections, themes, and niches

Maintain naming conventions and folder structures

Track which artwork has already been used

Coordinate artwork with mockups and listing graphics

Help determine which artwork may have strong commercial potential

Maintain cohesive visual presentation across collections

Support development of seasonal and evergreen product collections



The Coordinator does not need to create all artwork but should be comfortable working with AI-generated images and understand the importance of quality control.



AI-Assisted Content Creation



Use AI tools responsibly to increase efficiency across the business.



AI may be used to support:



Etsy descriptions

Etsy SEO research

Pinterest copy

Product titles

Product ideas

Website copy

Collection descriptions

Promotional content

Competitor research

Seasonal campaign ideas

Workflow development

Content repurposing



All AI-assisted work should be reviewed for quality, accuracy, brand alignment, and natural language before publication.



Website Completion & Maintenance



Assist with completing and maintaining the Rooted by Nyah website.



Responsibilities may include:



Upload products

Organize website collections

Update product descriptions

Update product imagery

Review site navigation

Check links and product pages

Identify incomplete or inconsistent areas

Improve visual consistency

Maintain product organization

Help create alignment between Etsy, Pinterest, Printify, and the website

Review the website from the customer's perspective and recommend improvements

Workflow & Systems Development



A major responsibility of this role will be helping create systems that make the business easier to operate and scale.



The Coordinator may help develop and maintain:



Standard Operating Procedures

Checklists

Product development workflows

Etsy listing workflows

Pinterest publishing workflows

Content calendars

Product trackers

Artwork databases

Keyword libraries

Listing templates

File organization standards

Publishing schedules

Recurring task systems

The goal is to avoid recreating the same process every time a new product is developed.

Posters

Identify underperforming listings

Review Pinterest performance

Track product launches

Monitor keyword opportunities

Research competitor positioning

Identify bundle opportunities

Recommend products for refresh or promotion

Help determine which products should be prioritized

The role does not require advanced data analysis, but the candidate should be comfortable using available information to make thoughtful recommendations.



Business & Project Organization



Help maintain a central operating system for the business that clearly shows:



Artwork in development

Finished artwork

Products being developed

Products ready to publish

Etsy listings

Listing URLs

Pinterest content

Printify products

Website products

Product categories

Keywords

Product ideas

Deadlines

Completed tasks

E-commerce

Pinterest

Pinterest SEO

Canva

Print-on-demand

Digital products

Website management

Shopify or similar e-commerce platforms

Notion

Highly organized

Detail-oriented

Visually aware

Proactive

Reliable

Comfortable learning new systems

Capable of working independently

Strong at managing multiple ongoing projects

Able to communicate clearly

Consistent with follow-through



We especially value someone who can identify repetitive work and ask:



“How can we create a better system for this?”



What Success Looks Like



A successful Coordinator will help create a business where:



Etsy listings are consistently optimized and maintained

New products are published regularly

Pinterest content is scheduled consistently

Existing products are continuously repurposed into marketing content

Printify products remain organized and updated

The website is completed and maintained

Artwork files are organized and easy to locate

New products follow a clear development process

Recurring tasks have documented workflows

Product performance is regularly reviewed

Strong-performing products are identified and expanded

The owner spends less time managing repetitive operational tasks

Schedule & Compensation



This is a part-time remote position beginning at 15 hours per week.



Compensation: $8 USD per hour



Hours may increase over time depending on performance, business growth, workload, and the candidate's ability to take ownership of additional responsibilities.



This is intended to be a long-term position for the right candidate.



Application Requirements



To apply, please provide answers to the following questions:



Describe your experience managing or supporting an Etsy shop.

Provide links, screenshots, or examples of Etsy listings, e-commerce stores, Pinterest accounts, or products you have worked on.

Have you worked with Printify or another print-on-demand platform? If so, what responsibilities did you handle?

Which AI tools do you currently use professionally, and how do you use them?

If you were given 20 finished artwork files, explain how you would organize the process of turning them into Etsy products and Pinterest content.

Which organizational or project-management platforms have you used?

How do you typically stay organized when managing multiple recurring responsibilities?

Confirm that you are available for approximately 15 hours per week.



Please begin your application with the word ROOTED so we know you carefully reviewed the full job posting.



Applications that do not answer the requested questions may not be considered.



Selection Process



Qualified applicants may be invited to participate in:



Initial application review

Video interview

Small paid skills assessment

Final interview or discussion

Offer and onboarding



The paid assessment may include a sample Etsy listing, Pinterest content concept, and a short workflow exercise.



Growth Opportunity



This position has the potential to expand beyond 15 hours per week as the business grows.



The long-term goal is for this person to become highly familiar with Rooted by Nyah's products, systems, brand standards, and operating processes and eventually take greater ownership of the business's day-to-day e-commerce operations.

title: Seeking a Manuscript Editor
description:
Seeking a Manuscript Editor



I’m looking for an experienced editor to review a completed biographical manuscript before publication, focusing on internal consistency, repetition, organization, and clarity.



The work includes:



Identifying conflicting information or inconsistencies between chapters.



Flagging duplicate stories, repeated passages, and overlapping content.



Checking consistency in names, titles, headings, categories, and lists.



Reviewing chapter flow and identifying passages that need clarification.



Recommending where repetitive lessons or reflections can be shortened or combined.



Ensuring the introduction, chapter structure, and closing material work together cohesively.



Preserving the author’s voice, tone, and intended meaning throughout.



Deliverables



A separate, chapter-by-chapter review identifying each issue, its location, and a clear recommendation for resolving it.



Please do not make changes directly to the manuscript. All suggestions must be submitted separately so the author can review and implement them personally.



The ideal candidate has experience with book editing, strong attention to detail, and the ability to identify inconsistencies across a full manuscript.



Please send your relevant experience, a sample of previous editorial work, estimated turnaround time, and proposed fee. The manuscript must remain confidential.

title: Senior IT Project Manager (MSP) | 8+ Years IT | $20-$25/hr
description:
AllSafe IT is hiring a Senior Technical IT Project Manager with a strong infrastructure engineering background. You will own client projects from technical planning and design through implementation, troubleshooting, cutover, validation, documentation, and help desk handoff. You must be able to work at an engineering level while managing scope, budgets, schedules, and client communication.



This is a full-time, long-term remote role for someone based in the Philippines. A minimum of 8 years of overall relevant IT experience is required. Your background may include engineering, systems/network/cloud administration, technical support, IT leadership, and project delivery. You must also demonstrate ownership of IT projects from planning through delivery.



Pay and schedule



- USD $20-$25 per hour, depending on demonstrated relevant experience.

- 40 hours per week, Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM-5:00 PM US Pacific Time. Your schedule follows US daylight saving changes. This is an overnight shift in the Philippines.

- At 40 hours per week, the annualized monthly equivalent is approximately $3,467-$4,333. Actual pay is based on hours worked.

- You will work directly with our team.



What you'll own



You will lead multiple client infrastructure projects, including client onboarding, Windows server and Active Directory changes, Microsoft 365 and Azure migrations, virtualization and storage, new office networks, firewall and security deployments, backup and disaster recovery, and enterprise telephony. You will understand the architecture, implementation sequence, risks, and recovery options and take personal responsibility for technical delivery.



Your responsibilities include:



- Turn an agreed scope into a project plan with tasks, owners, dependencies, milestones, resource assignments, and budgeted hours.

- Keep project plans, notes, decisions, schedules, and status current in ConnectWise.

- Lead kickoff, progress, and closeout meetings. Give clients clear updates on what is complete, what comes next, and any decisions they need to make.

- Architect, implement, troubleshoot, and validate infrastructure solutions within your expertise. Lead engineers and vendors effectively, review their technical work, and resolve implementation blockers.

- Track budget against actual hours, identify scope changes, and obtain the appropriate decisions and approvals before extra work proceeds.

- Raise risks and delays early, with their impact and a proposed next step.

- Own cutover and rollback planning, testing, technical documentation, acceptance, and operational handoff to the help desk.



What we're looking for



- At least 8 years of overall relevant IT experience, with a demonstrated track record of owning IT project scope, schedules, budgets, client communication, and delivery. Your work history should show your engineering, support, administration, leadership, and project responsibilities. MSP or other client-facing IT services experience is especially relevant.

- Strong spoken and written English, careful listening, and the ability to clarify a request and explain technical progress in plain language.

- Working knowledge of ConnectWise project workflows, or a comparable PSA platform with the ability to become effective in ConnectWise quickly.

- A demonstrated engineering background in infrastructure, systems, networking, cloud, or a comparable technical delivery role. You must show personal design, implementation, troubleshooting, and validation responsibilities in real infrastructure projects.

- Strong experience across relevant infrastructure domains such as Windows Server and AD/Entra identity, Microsoft 365/Azure, networks and firewalls, virtualization/storage, backup/disaster recovery, and enterprise voice. Equivalent vendor experience is accepted; every product is not required.

- The ability to diagnose complex infrastructure issues, evaluate designs and dependencies, lead cutovers, and develop rollback and recovery plans.

- CRM implementation, marketing automation, administrative coordination, and software product delivery alone do not meet this infrastructure requirement.

- Consistent organization and follow-through across multiple clients and a distributed team.

- A reliable computer, internet connection, and workspace suitable for client video calls.



Substantial engineering or advanced technical-delivery experience, combined with proven infrastructure project delivery, is expected. PMP, ITIL, and relevant Microsoft, networking, security, or virtualization credentials support demonstrated experience; they do not replace it.



How to apply



Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph with:



1. Your resume with month/year dates for your IT roles, showing at least 8 years of overall relevant IT experience. Highlight your project-delivery responsibilities separately. Count overlapping roles once; eight years exclusively in project management is not required.

2. Two substantial infrastructure projects you delivered. For each, name the infrastructure involved, your personal design/configuration/troubleshooting actions, the cutover and rollback approach, validation, scope, timeline, budget or resource hours, and result. Separate what you personally did from work done by other engineers. Please leave out confidential client information.

3. Your experience with ConnectWise or other project management and PSA tools.

4. A link to a 1-2 minute introduction video explaining one infrastructure project, the technical problem and your own engineering contribution, and how you kept the client informed.

5. Confirmation that you can work the Pacific schedule, your earliest start date, and your expected hourly rate.

title: Experienced U.S. Tax Preparer / Senior Tax Accountant
description:
Company: Ensign Partners

Location: Philippines, Remote

Job Type: Full-time, long-term

Compensation: $12–$15 USD per hour - negotiable based on experience. 

Schedule: Full-time U.S. Arizona business hours



ABOUT ENSIGN PARTNERS



Ensign Partners is an integrated professional services firm that brings legal, tax, financial, insurance, and business advisory services together under one team.



Our goal is not simply to complete individual tasks. We work together to help business owners organize their companies, make better decisions, protect what they have built, and confidently move their businesses forward.



We are building a team of dependable professionals who take ownership, communicate clearly, execute consistently, and care about the people they serve.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for an experienced U.S. Tax Preparer / Senior Tax Accountant based in the Philippines to join our growing Tax team.



This is a U.S. tax preparation position, NOT a bookkeeping position.



The ideal candidate has significant, hands-on experience preparing U.S. federal and state income tax returns for individuals and businesses, including Forms 1040, 1065, 1120, and 1120-S.



You must have actual experience preparing returns using professional U.S. tax software, preferably Intuit ProConnect Tax, and understand U.S. tax compliance, deductions, adjustments, supporting schedules, and filing requirements.



You will work directly with Ensign's U.S.-based Tax team to prepare accurate returns, identify issues, manage deadlines, and move completed work through review and authorized filing.



We are looking for someone who can independently prepare tax returns, not someone who needs to be trained in U.S. taxation from the beginning.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



U.S. TAX RETURN PREPARATION



Independently prepare U.S. individual income tax returns (Form 1040), including relevant schedules and supporting documentation.



Prepare U.S. business tax returns, including Forms 1065, 1120, and 1120-S.



Prepare applicable state income tax returns, extensions, and amended returns.



Review client financial statements, prior-year returns, and supporting records to identify missing information, discrepancies, and tax adjustments.



Apply U.S. federal and state tax rules to accurately calculate taxable income, deductions, credits, and other tax items.



Prepare complete tax workpapers and documentation for senior review.



Identify potential tax compliance issues and opportunities for tax planning.



Coordinate with the U.S. Tax team to resolve review comments and finalize returns for authorized filing.



TAX TEAM SUPPORT



Manage multiple tax returns and assignments while meeting internal deadlines and filing requirements.



Communicate missing information, outstanding questions, and tax issues to the appropriate team members.



Assist with tax research, estimated tax calculations, and other tax compliance projects.



Maintain accurate client records, tax documentation, and task updates.



Help improve tax preparation processes, checklists, and quality standards.



Collaborate with Ensign's Tax and advisory professionals to support accurate, timely client service.



CLIENT COMMUNICATION



Communicate professionally with U.S.-based clients and internal team members through
 and virtual meetings.



Request missing tax documents, financial information, and clarification when needed.



Explain tax-related questions clearly and professionally.



Provide consistent updates on assigned work and outstanding items.



Demonstrate accountability, accuracy, confidentiality, and dependable follow-through.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS



Active Philippine CPA license or U.S. CPA credential preferred, with substantial U.S. tax preparation experience required.



5+ years of professional tax preparation experience, including at least 3 years preparing U.S. federal income tax returns.



Demonstrated hands-on experience preparing Forms 1040, 1065, 1120, and 1120-S.



Experience preparing U.S. federal and state tax returns using professional tax software.



Intuit ProConnect Tax experience strongly preferred.



Experience preparing complete returns for review, rather than only collecting documents or supporting bookkeeping.



Strong knowledge of U.S. federal income tax concepts, business entity taxation, deductions, depreciation, and tax adjustments.



Ability to read financial statements, review trial balances, and prepare tax-related adjusting entries.



Experience working with U.S.-based accounting or tax firms strongly preferred.



Strong Excel skills and familiarity with QuickBooks Online financial reports.



Excellent written and spoken English.



Ability to work independently, maintain confidentiality, and meet deadlines.



IMPORTANT: We are specifically seeking applicants with proven U.S. tax return preparation experience. General accounting, Philippine tax compliance, and bookkeeping experience alone will not qualify for this position.



OUR CORE VALUES



ENJOY THE JOURNEY

We work hard, maintain perspective, support one another, and bring a positive attitude to the work we do.



MOVE THE CHEESE

We adapt when circumstances change. We do not remain stuck in old processes simply because they are familiar.



BE YOUR BEST

We prepare, improve, accept feedback, and consistently work to become better professionals and teammates.



AIM TO WIN

We approach our work with purpose. We set meaningful goals, solve problems, and focus on producing strong results.



RAISE THE BAR

We do not settle for average work. We look for ways to improve our quality, service, systems, and execution.



KEEP YOUR WORD

We do what we say we will do. When circumstances change, we communicate early and take responsibility.



STRONGER AS ONE

We share information, help our teammates, and make decisions based on what is best for the client and the entire company.



WHY JOIN ENSIGN PARTNERS?



Full-time, long-term opportunity.



Work with a growing U.S.-based professional services company.



Be part of a collaborative team.



Work directly with experienced business, legal, insurance, financial, and tax professionals.



Opportunity to grow as Ensign Partners grows.



Make a meaningful contribution to our clients and our team.



HOW TO APPLY



Please follow these instructions carefully.



Do NOT
 us directly. Applicants who
 outside this job posting will be disqualified.



Use this subject line: Experienced U.S. Tax Preparer at Ensign Partners



Include the following: Your updated resume.

A brief introduction explaining why you are interested in this position.

How many years of hands-on U.S. tax return preparation experience do you have?

Which U.S. tax forms have you personally prepared? Specify Forms 1040, 1065, 1120, and 1120-S.



Compensation is $12–$15 USD per hour, depending on demonstrated experience and qualifications. Our main goal is we get the right candidates.



Work hours are full-time U.S. Arizona business hours. This is a FULL TIME, LONG TERM position.

**Lead Operations & Data QA Specialist – US Small Business Lending – Full-Time, Long-Term**



**Pay:** $800–$1,200 per month, based on experience. **Hours:** must overlap US Eastern business hours. The daily report is due by 8:30am ET, Monday to Friday. **Location:** Philippines preferred. **Start:** Monday, November 23.



**About 
.** We help US small businesses get funding through a panel of 25 to 40 funders. We buy and generate leads across several channels, and every dollar has to be tracked to funded deals.



**The role.** You keep our lead pipeline clean and our numbers honest. You report to our Head of Borrower Acquisition. Every lead that enters our CRM goes through you, and every morning you report which channels produce funded deals at an acceptable cost.



**What you will do**



- **Feed inserts.** Load lead feeds into the CRM by API, webhook or CSV. Map the fields and fix failed inserts the same day.

- **Dedupe.** Before anyone works a new record, match it against the CRM and the suppression list using phone,
, business name, EIN and address.

- **List scrubbing.** Remove invalid, disconnected and suppressed records, and keep the suppression list current.

- **Aged records.** An aged record goes back into the CRM only after a documented re-permission event. There are no exceptions.

- **Attribution.** Run dynamic number insertion (DNI) and call tracking so every call and form fill is tied to its source, campaign and cost. Check it daily.

- **Daily reporting.** By 8:30am ET, publish closing leads, approval rate and cost per funded account by channel and vendor.

- **Alerts.** If a channel runs above the blended cost-per-funded ceiling three days in a row, flag it that morning.



**Must have**



- 2+ years in lead operations, marketing operations, CRM administration or data QA for a US performance-marketing, lending or insurance business.

- Advanced Google Sheets or Excel, including XLOOKUP or VLOOKUP, pivot tables, QUERY and conditional formulas, plus comfort with large CSV files.

- CRM administration experience, for example Salesforce, HubSpot, GoHighLevel or Zoho.

- Familiarity with call tracking and DNI tools such as CallRail, Ringba or Invoca, and with UTM-based attribution.

- Precise written English, and you notice when numbers do not add up.



**How we hire.** There are five steps: screening questions, a 20-minute video screen, a paid 2-hour data test, a live final interview with an ID check, and two references. We plan to make an offer by November 19 for a November 23 start.



**No-proxy policy.** The person we interview must be the person who does the work. You may not subcontract or share your account. Breaking this policy ends the contract immediately.



**To apply, answer the screening questions and start your cover letter with the words CLEAN DATA.**

 Required Screening Questions



Please answer all five questions as part of your application.



1. Describe the lead feeds and CRM you managed most recently. Include the daily volume, the sources and the tools.



2. How would you dedupe 5,000 new leads against a CRM of 200,000 records when phone formats and business names don't match exactly?



3. How do you set up and check dynamic number insertion so each call is credited to the right channel?



4. Channel A spent $3,000 and produced 20 funded deals. Channel B spent $1,500 and produced 5. If the ceiling is $200 per funded deal, what do you report?



5. Can you deliver a daily report by 8:30am US Eastern, Monday to Friday, starting Monday, November 23?

Pay Structure & Trial:

 $20 USD / Day (~$400–$440 USD / month) guaranteed base pay.

 10% Commission for every cleaning you book.
