title: Amazon Operations Manager - Private Label Brand (US & Canada), AI-Forward Role
description:
ABOUT US



We are a Canadian private-label brand. We sell on Amazon in the US and Canada, and we also sell direct to universities and medical training programs across North America. Around 15 product lines. Small team: a PPC manager, a few VAs, and the owner.



We are at an interesting moment. We are rebuilding this role from the ground up and automating the repetitive half of it with AI agents, right now, before anyone starts. You would not be inheriting a mess. You would be stepping into a documented system and helping decide what gets built next.



THE ROLE



Full-time, 35 hours a week.



The repetitive half of this job is being automated as you read this: shipment tracking, delivery-window monitoring, freight quote generation, supplier chasing, listing suppression alerts. You are not here to produce reports. You are here to close the things those systems surface, and then to grow the business.



- Inbound logistics. Build FBA and AWD shipment plans. Request freight quotes, check them against our cost-per-unit history, and recommend. Keep every shipment moving and every delivery window current. Handle customs documentation.

- Suppliers. Place orders with our factories in China and Hong Kong, hold them to production dates, check invoices against what was agreed, manage print files and samples.

- Account health. Work the suppressions and listing issues our monitoring flags. File and escalate Amazon cases, including past first-line support. Keep compliance documentation current: CPC certificates, safety documents, HTS codes.

- Inventory. Days of cover by ASIN and by marketplace, reorder recommendations, Q4 and Chinese New Year build-ahead, FBA capacity and restock limits.

- Listings and pricing. Copy and title upkeep, coupons and sale prices, Buy Box monitoring, competitor scanning.

- Marketing materials. Listing images, infographics and promotional pieces, produced with AI tools and briefed out to a designer when the job genuinely needs one.

- Growth, and this is the half that matters most. Two of our product lines have declined significantly and we want them back. Per-ASIN analysis, ranking and listing recovery, pricing work. Specific trackable actions, worked one at a time, with results measured.

- AI tooling. You will inherit the automation we are building, use it every day, tell us where it is wrong, and help decide what gets built next.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT



It is not a reporting job. We have had plenty of status updates that went nowhere. Every red item comes with a recommendation, every recommendation gets a decision, and every decision gets acted on and closed. If you like finishing things, you will like this role.



WHO SUPPLIES THE JUDGMENT



Increasingly, you do. We will give you written procedures, an approval matrix with real dollar limits so you can spend without asking, and a working automation layer. What we will not do is hand you a task list every morning.



The thing we care most about is whether you close the loop. Verify after you push a change. Check a number against history before you forward it. Tell the person affected what was decided. Build a reminder for anything that happens every year. We would rather hire someone with one year of experience and that instinct than five years without it.



WHAT YOU MUST HAVE



- At least one year of hands-on Amazon Seller Central work, in-house or at an agency. We are not expecting you to have seen everything. We are expecting you to already know what a flat file is, how a shipment plan works and what a suppressed listing looks like, so the only genuinely new thing is our products.

- Real AI fluency, and enthusiasm for it. You already use Claude, ChatGPT or similar in your actual work. You are curious about agents and automation, you have tried building something, and you want to get much better at it. A large part of this role is working alongside automation we are building now and telling us where it should go next. If AI is something you have read about but never used in anger, this is not the role.

- The judgment to distrust AI output. This matters as much as the point above. We were once burned by an AI inventing freight fees that did not exist, and it cost us a week on a time-critical shipment. We want someone who leans on these tools hard and still checks them.

- Basic design ability, AI-assisted. You do not need to be a graphic designer. You do need real experience producing marketing materials with AI tools: listing images, infographics, promotional graphics. Just as important is knowing when something is good enough to publish and when it should go to a professional.

- Business-fluent written English. This role writes Amazon appeals and instructions to Chinese suppliers. Both have to be unambiguous.

- Self-direction. You will work four hours a day before anyone in Toronto is awake. Nobody is watching you work, so you need to be the kind of person who picks the next most important thing without being told.

- Comfort with spreadsheets. Enough to hold a cost model in your head and notice when a number is wrong.

- Genuine interest in online business. Ecommerce, marketplaces, brands, how they grow. Not just a job in a browser.



STRONG PLUS



- A marketing degree or marketing studies. Underneath all the logistics, this is a marketing business: listings, ranking, pricing, positioning, conversion. Formal marketing grounding helps you understand why the operational work exists.

- Canva or light Photoshop beyond the AI tools, and print-file literacy.

- Experience briefing and quoting an outside designer.



WHAT WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR



Years of agency seniority, or product research and arbitrage experience presented as private-label work. We would rather train the right person than rent a long CV. If you are early in your career, ambitious and genuinely interested in this, you are exactly who this posting is for.



HOURS AND SCHEDULE



Full-time, 35 hours a week, on a tapered schedule: a strong start to the week and short Fridays. Same start time every day, finishing earlier as the week goes on. All times Philippine time.



Monday: 4:00pm to 12:00am (8 hours)

Tuesday: 4:00pm to 12:00am (8 hours)

Wednesday: 4:00pm to 11:00pm (7 hours)

Thursday: 4:00pm to 10:00pm (6 hours)

Friday: 4:00pm to 10:00pm (6 hours)



This is an evening shift and we want to be completely clear about that before you apply. The reason is overlap. The owner is in Toronto, so these hours mean you work four hours on your own each day and then have real live time together: four hours on Monday and Tuesday, tapering through the week. You open each day with what happened and what needs deciding, rather than waiting to be told what to do.



There is no night differential. The rate reflects the schedule.



The schedule is anchored to Toronto time, so the Philippine clock shifts one hour later between November and March when North America changes clocks. Monday and Tuesday become 5:00pm to 1:00am in that period.



If you need to shift hours occasionally, that is fine. If you lose power or need time off, tell us early. We would much rather know.



Please do not apply if an evening schedule does not genuinely suit you. It is a real constraint, we have had it go wrong before, and a candidate who takes it reluctantly ends up worse off than one who never applied.



HOW WE TRACK TIME



We use DeskTime for hourly time tracking, which takes periodic screenshots. We are telling you up front because some people are not comfortable with it, and that is a fair position. Better to know now than after you start.



To be clear about what it is for: it counts hours for payroll. It is not how your work gets judged. Reviews are based on what you closed and what moved.



Screenshot tracking comes off after 90 days once your hours are established. Time logging stays, because that is how you get paid.



COMPENSATION



USD 7.00 per hour for 35 hours a week, paid twice monthly by Wise against logged hours. That is roughly USD 1,060 per month, plus 13th-month pay, so about USD 1,150 per month all in.



On top of that, one bonus, and only one: 10% of the growth in monthly profit against the same period a year earlier.



That is the whole incentive structure. We deliberately did not build a dozen small commissions, because a bonus you have to argue about is worse than no bonus. One number, taken from the P&L, paid quarterly.



How it works in practice. If the business was averaging USD 10,000 a month in profit over the year before you joined, and it runs at USD 12,000, that is USD 2,000 of growth and USD 200 a month to you, so USD 600 a quarter. It is measured on a three-month rolling average against the matching three months of your baseline year, so one early shipment or one late freight invoice cannot distort it.



It counts growth from both directions. Sell more and it goes up. Find a cheaper freight lane, cut a fee, fix a margin, and it goes up the same way. We want someone who actually reads the numbers, not someone who only thinks about the top line.



We will show you the profit figure. You cannot be accountable for a number you are not allowed to see.



Being straight with you about the timing. Two of our product lines have declined this year. Your baseline is the twelve months immediately before you start, so you are not being measured against someone else's better year, but the bonus will still likely pay nothing for your first few months while you find your feet. The near-term upside is the 90-day review and raise. The growth share is the long game, and it is uncapped.



A formal review at 90 days with a raise if it has gone well, and annually after that. We would rather grow someone into this role and keep paying them more than hire cheap and replace them every year.



WHERE THIS ROLE GOES



Be honest with yourself about whether this appeals. The rate is a starting point, not a ceiling, and the reason we are hiring at this level is that we would rather find someone early and grow them than rent seniority.



In twelve months the person in this role should be deciding freight routes without asking, running the supplier relationships directly, owning the growth plan for two or three product lines, and telling us what the automation should do next rather than waiting to be told. If that sounds like the job you want, apply. If you are looking for steady task work at a fixed scope, this will frustrate you and we would rather you knew now.



HOW TO APPLY



Do not send a generic cover letter. Send us four things:



1. The hardest Amazon problem you have personally worked on. What was broken, what you tried, what actually worked, and how long it took. If it never got solved, say so. That is a fine answer.

2. A freight quote comes back at USD 0.91 per unit. How would you know whether that is reasonable?

3. What you use AI for in your actual work, and one time it gave you something wrong that you caught.

4. A link or two to marketing materials you have made, and which tools you used.



Applications that skip question 2 or question 3 will not be read.



We may ask a shortlisted candidate to do a short paid task on a real open problem from our backlog before we commit, so you can see the work and we can see how you think.

Help improve internal workflows and overall efficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

Policy persistency and client retention.

Reinstating lapsed life insurance policies.

Following up on insurance chargebacks.

Working directly with insurance agents or independent brokerages.

Insurance CRM systems and commission tracking.

Calling clients about missed premium payments.

Coordinating policy cancellation paperwork.

Consistent Monday–Friday schedule.

Long-term opportunity with a growing U.S. insurance brokerage.

Opportunity for increased responsibilities and compensation based on performance.

Training on our internal systems and procedures.



How to Apply

To be considered, please submit the following:

Important: To confirm that you have read the full job description, please begin your application with the words “INSURANCE VA READY”.



Your resume and a brief description of your previous insurance or virtual assistant experience.

Your experience handling lapsed policies, missed premium payments, reinstatements, or cancellation requests.

Confirmation that you are comfortable working Monday through Friday on U.S. Eastern Time and using screen-monitoring software during paid working hours.



We are looking for someone dependable who wants to become a valuable, long-term member of our team. If you have strong communication skills, relevant insurance experience, and take pride in keeping operations organized, we encourage you to apply.

About KKBOS

Position overview

* Contact business owners and operational leaders by phone,
, and video meeting.

Performance expectations



Success is measured by meaningful progress through the sales process, including timely lead response, completed discovery conversations, qualified demonstrations, consistent follow-up, accurate CRM records, signed contracts, and collected revenue.

KKBOS follows a “diagnose before you prescribe” approach. title: Patient Accounts Reconciliation Specialist (PRN Contractor)
description:
The Purpose of Your Role   



The primary objective of this project is to research, identify, and accurately post unallocated payments, credits, and undistributed funds within our patient accounting system. You will investigate historical transactions, resolve variances, and ensure that patient accounts reflect precise, up-to-date financial balances in compliance with company policies and healthcare regulations. 





The Company You’ll Join 



OCD Anxiety Centers is the nation’s largest provider of IOP services for individuals dealing with OCD, Anxiety, and Trauma. As the leading provider, our clinical outcomes are second to none. You will join a winning team that is committed to evidence-based treatment and long-term results. We are passionate about bringing help and hope to some of the most underserved clinical populations. We strive to change the lives of individuals and their families suffering from unrelenting anxiety, disturbing and terrifying thoughts, uncontrollable worry, exhausting behaviors and rituals, and avoidance that keeps them from living their lives. We are an evidence-based practice, which means we do what works, stay current with scientific research, and regularly attend international training to keep us at our very best. Our values are as follows:  



Growth 

Proactivity 

Positivity 

Results Driven 





Our Investment in You 

A competitive base salary starting at $9 to $11 per hour 





Responsibilities 



Research Unallocated Monies: Audit patient accounts to identify the root cause of unallocated payments,  

 overpayments, unidentified clearinghouse credits, and misapplied funds. 



Accurate Payment Posting: Post, adjust, and reallocate payments to correct patient encounters or line items in accordance with explanation of benefits (EOBs), remittances, and patient receipts. 



Account Reconciliation: Balance and reconcile daily or batch posting workflows against bank deposits and financial system logs. 



Error Resolution: Identify systemic trends causing unallocated balances (e.g., clearinghouse issues, front-desk collection errors) and report findings to management. 



Compliance Management: Ensure all adjustments, refunds, or balance transfers strictly adhere to HIPAA guidelines, internal control procedures, and healthcare billing compliance standards. 



Adheres to all company policies and procedures 



Other duties as assigned 



 



Qualifications 



Experience: Minimum of 2–3 years of experience in healthcare medical billing, patient accounts receivable, or healthcare payment posting. 



Technical Skills: High proficiency with Electronic Health Record (EHR) and practice management software (e.g., Epic, Cerner, eClinicalWorks, or similar billing platforms). Advanced Excel skills (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables) are highly preferred. 



Knowledge Base: Strong understanding of medical billing terminology, EOB interpretation, coordination of benefits (COB), and healthcare accounting practices. 



Attributes: Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and auditing skills; ability to work independently with minimal supervision. 



 



Project Timeline & Performance KPIs 



Should this contract extend, performance will be evaluated against the following milestones to measure efficiency, speed, and accuracy: 



 



30-Day KPIs (Onboarding & Accuracy Baseline) 



 Complete standard system training and demonstrate proficiency in navigating the practice management ledger. 



 Establish a steady daily review cadence, auditing a minimum of 35-40 unallocated transactions per day. 



 Maintain a posting and reconciliation accuracy rate of 99% or higher on all audited accounts. 



 



60-Day KPIs (Volume Acceleration & Error Reduction) 



 Increase daily workflow throughput to audit and resolve a minimum of 45–50 unallocated transactions per day. 



 Achieve a posting accuracy rate of 99% or higher with minimal supervision or need for posting reversals. 



 Successfully identify, categorize, and document at least two major root causes of systemic unallocated funds to assist the permanent team in preventative measures. 





Note: This is a PRN (as-needed) position, meaning there is no fixed work schedule or guaranteed number of hours.

title: Payments Reconciliation Lead
description:
Payments Reconciliation Lead - Contract



Job Description

WHO WE ARE

Customer is the most valued partner for K–12 schools to build trust, strengthen community, and grow enrollment. Ranked among the best EdTech Companies in America, Customer supports more than 7,000 schools and districts worldwide with an integrated platform for websites, communications, mobile apps, enrollment, and marketing services.

Headquartered in Glastonbury, Connecticut, Customer is a global company with employees working remotely across nearly every U.S. state, as well as throughout Europe, South America, and Asia.

We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, connected, and empowered to grow. That’s why we invest in our employees through competitive benefits, professional development opportunities, and a collaborative culture built on partnership and purpose. Whether you’re looking to expand your skills, take on new challenges, or make a meaningful impact in education, Customer offers the opportunity to grow your career while helping schools thrive.

At Customer, every interaction matters — with our clients, with each other, and with the schools and families we serve. Join us and help shape stronger school communities around the world



SUMMARY

Customer gives K-12 schools and districts one connected suite for their websites, communications, enrollment and payments, used by about 7,000 districts and schools. Payments is the part of that suite that ties the others together: a family that gets a message from the school, enrolls a student and pays a fee should see one experience, and the district's finance office should see one clean set of books. We are building a reconciliation service to support our largest district clients as that suite comes together, and we are looking for a Payments Reconciliation Lead to build it and run it. You will set up the procedures, hire and train a small team, and be the person who makes sure a district's numbers tie every day. You report to the Sr. Accounting Manager and work daily with Customer Success, who own the client relationship, and with Product. This is a contract-to-hire role.



RESPONSIBILITIES

•  Runbooks: Turn each district's reconciliation workflow, from the first chargeback notice to the final tie-out against settlement, into written procedures with quality checks.

•  Team: Hire and train 5 to 10 reconciliation specialists through a staffing partner or an offshore vendor.

•  Daily Tracking: Run a daily tracker of which task, which client, who did it and who reviewed it.

•  Quality Review: Review every file before it goes out. Nothing reaches a district unchecked.

•  Client Reporting: Send a weekly status to each client's Customer Success Manager, who owns the client conversation. Make sure they walk in with the facts.

•  Chargeback Notices: Own the handoff from Operations so each district gets a complete notice with the order and transaction detail attached, instead of a screenshot in an
.

•  Line-Item Reconstruction: Locate each affected order in the Web Store portal, rebuild it at the line-item level with the account or GL code from Inventory, the payment ID, the dollar amount and the sales tax, and lay it out the same way as the district's settlement file.

•  Fix Files: Produce the ERP-ready correction file, broken into the right accounting lines with sales tax, in the district's import format (Munis, for example), and confirm it posted.

•  Settlement Tie-Out: Reconcile the individual orders and the fix-file detail back to the single aggregated chargeback deduction on the settlement statement.

•  Related Notices: Extend the same approach to delayed or unfunded transactions and to disputes and NSF returns, so districts get one daily file instead of one
 at a time.

•  Automation Input: Keep a ranked list of what is slow and which report fields would remove each step, and hand it to Product and Engineering.

•  Capacity and Cost: Track hours per client per workflow, build the capacity model for the full client list, and recommend US temps versus offshore from real error and turnaround data.

•  Performance Measures: Same-day task completion, files out by the agreed cutoff, business days from chargeback notice to ERP-ready file, disputes surfaced within one business day, fix files that tie with no rework, and automation requests accepted by engineering.



QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

•  5+ years in accounting operations, treasury, payments or merchant services, with bank or settlement reconciliation as your own daily work, not something you reviewed from above.

•  2+ years leading, training or supervising a reconciliation or back-office team. Temp or offshore staff is a plus.

•  Experience writing procedures and quality checks that other people followed.

•  Working knowledge of the card dispute and chargeback process from the merchant side, including evidence deadlines.

•  Experience producing or validating ERP import files. Munis is a plus.

•  Advanced Excel: lookups, SUMIFS, pivots, large CSV cleanup.

•  Ability to explain a reconciliation break to someone who is not an accountant.

•  CPA, CMA or an accounting degree is a plus.

•  Payment processor, payment facilitator or bank operations background is a plus.

•  K-12 or public sector fund accounting is a plus.

•  Experience managing a staffing partner or an offshore vendor is a plus.

•  Experience handing a manual process to a product team to automate is a plus.

title: Payment Reconciliation Specialist
description:
SUMMARY

Customer gives K-12 schools and districts one connected suite for their websites, communications, enrollment and payments, used by about 7,000 districts and schools. As that suite comes together, our largest district clients need their payment records to tie out to their accounting systems every day, and we are building a small reconciliation team to make sure they do. We are hiring Payments Reconciliation Specialists on contract to do the daily work: following written procedures, working in Excel and a few web portals, and getting each file right before it goes out. You report to the Payments Reconciliation Lead. The role is tied to a defined program and is filled through a US staffing partner or an offshore vendor.



RESPONSIBILITIES

•  Chargeback Intake: Pick up each chargeback notice from Operations and log it the same day.

•  Order Lookup: Find each affected order in the Web Store portal. A charged-back order can still show as successful, so work from the notice, not the status.

•  Line-Item Reconstruction: List every item on the order and capture the account or GL code from Inventory, the payment ID, the dollar amount and the sales tax, in the same layout as the district's settlement file.

•  Fix File: Build the correction file, broken into the right accounting lines with sales tax, and format it to the district's ERP import (Munis, for example).

•  Settlement Tie-Out: Reconcile the orders and the fix-file detail back to the single aggregated chargeback deduction on the settlement statement. It has to match to the cent.

•  Related Notices: Prepare the daily file of delayed or unfunded transactions, and of disputes and NSF returns, for each of your clients.

•  Quality Check: Run the runbook checklist, then hand your work to the Lead for review. Nothing goes out without a second set of eyes until the Lead lifts that rule for you.

•  Delivery: After review, send the file to the client's Customer Success Manager, who passes it to the district. You never contact a district directly.

•  Escalation: Raise it with the Lead when a SKU has no account code or two of them, when you cannot find an order, when a chargeback is partial, when anything does not tie, when a tax question comes up, or when a runbook step fails or does not cover the request. Never change a template or skip a check on your own.

•  Automation Input: Keep a running note of what is slow or awkward. You will be asked what should be automated.



QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

•  2+ years of hands-on work in cash application, accounts receivable or payable, bank reconciliation, merchant services or payment processor operations, or bookkeeping for a business with card sales.

•  Experience tying detail to a total: many items to one deposit, statement line or batch, and working the differences rather than just flagging them.

•  Excel: XLOOKUP or VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, pivot tables, text-to-columns, saving a clean CSV.

•  Ability to follow a written procedure exactly, and to say so when a step does not work.

•  Accuracy under a daily deadline, and the habit of keeping a log without being asked.

•  Clear written English, for short notes that go to districts under the Lead's name.

•  Chargebacks, disputes or NSF returns from the merchant side are a plus.

•  An ERP import or export (Munis, Skyward, QuickBooks, NetSuite) is a plus.

•  A payment processor portal or settlement statement is a plus.

•  School district, municipal or nonprofit finance is a plus.

•  Required: an accounting degree, a CPA, coding, or any product or engineering background.

title: YouTube Video Editor (Long-form & Shorts)
description:
You'll be building a YouTube channel for a B2B founder, and we need an editor who does more than cut footage. You'll turn raw recordings into sharp, high-retention videos and play an active part in growing the channel: packaging, hooks, formats and iterating on what the data shows.



The editing direction is clear: the retention and clarity of Alex Hormozi, with the production value of Iman Gadzhi. If you know both styles well and can switch between them, or blend them, keep reading.



The style we're after

Alex Hormozi: retention-first, value-dense

• Tight jump cuts with dead air, breaths and filler removed

• A pattern interrupt every few seconds: punch-in zooms, angle changes, on-screen text, graphics

• Bold, animated word-by-word captions with key words highlighted

• Sound effects on every beat (whooshes, pops, hits) to drive energy

• On-screen frameworks, lists and visuals that reinforce the point being made

• Hooks that state the payoff in the first 5 seconds



Iman Gadzhi: cinematic, premium, story-driven

• Cinematic colour grading and a consistent premium look

• High-quality b-roll, shallow depth of field, smooth camera movement

• Speed ramps, match cuts and clean transitions

• Music-driven pacing and layered sound design (ambience, risers, drops)

• Documentary and vlog-style storytelling with a clear narrative arc

• Minimal, elegant typography and motion graphics

Our blend: Hormozi pacing and captions for talking-head and educational content, Gadzhi visuals and storytelling for intros, b-roll sequences, vlogs and brand moments. Shorts lean Hormozi; long-form uses both.



What you'll do

• Edit long-form videos and short-form clips (Shorts, Reels, TikTok): cuts, pacing, captions, b-roll, colour, sound design

• Repurpose long-form into multiple shorts with strong standalone hooks

• Design thumbnails and co-write titles that earn clicks

• Suggest hooks, structure and formats that improve retention

• Build and maintain a reusable editing kit: caption styles, SFX library, LUTs, templates, motion graphics presets

• Track performance in YouTube Studio (CTR, average view duration, retention graphs) and iterate based on what the data shows

• Bring ideas: video concepts, format tests and references from what works in the niche



What we're looking for

• Proven editing experience with a portfolio or channel examples, ideally including Hormozi- or Gadzhi-style work

• A strong sense of pacing, storytelling and retention. You know why viewers drop off and how to stop it

• Familiarity with YouTube growth mechanics: CTR, watch time, retention, packaging

• Fluency in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro, plus After Effects or similar for motion

• Confident with colour grading and audio cleanup

• Self-directed, reliable with deadlines and comfortable owning outcomes, not just tasks

• Clear written English for async communication



Bonus points

• Motion graphics and thumbnail design skills (Photoshop, Figma or similar)

• Experience growing a channel from early stage to established

• Experience editing B2B, business or educational content

• Basic scripting or hook-writing skills



What success looks like in 90 days

• A consistent, recognisable visual style across long-form, shorts and thumbnails

• A repeatable editing workflow with fast, predictable turnaround

• Measurable improvement in CTR and average view duration versus our baseline

• At least a few format or packaging tests run, with clear learnings



How to apply

Send us:

1. Your portfolio or showreel

2. Two or three videos you edited, ideally with view, CTR or retention stats

3. One example in the Hormozi or Gadzhi style (or both), with a short note on the choices you made

4. Your availability, expected weekly volume and rate

Shortlisted candidates will complete a short, paid test edit on our own footage.



Submit the information here:

title: Shopify Operations Manager
description:
Shopify Operations Manager — E-commerce (Part-Time, Remote)



About Us



We are launching two US-based e-commerce brands:



Above — A curated men’s fashion brand focused on contemporary, minimalist clothing.

KAEN — A women’s jewelry brand offering a curated selection of modern jewelry.



Both brands operate on Shopify, with products sourced primarily from China and sold to customers in the United States.



We already have Shopify developers, product upload specialists, suppliers, and fulfillment partners in place.



We’re looking for a highly organized, proactive Shopify Operations Manager who can oversee day-to-day operations, coordinate our existing freelancers, and ensure projects are completed efficiently.



This is not a basic virtual assistant or product listing role. We’re looking for someone who can take ownership of projects, solve problems independently, and keep both businesses moving forward without constant supervision.



Key Responsibilities



1. Shopify Store Operations



* Oversee daily operations across two Shopify stores.

* Coordinate product uploads, updates, and catalog organization.

* Review product listings for accuracy, including descriptions, pricing, images, variants, and product information.

* Perform quality checks on product pages, collections, navigation, and mobile layouts.

* Identify website issues and coordinate fixes with Shopify developers.

* Verify that completed website changes meet requirements.

* Help prepare both stores for launch and ongoing operations.



2. Project & Freelancer Management



* Coordinate existing Shopify developers, product upload assistants, designers, and other contractors.

* Assign tasks, establish deadlines, and follow up on deliverables.

* Maintain an organized project-management system.

* Track outstanding tasks, dependencies, and blockers.

* Ensure projects move forward without constant founder involvement.

* Provide clear, concise daily progress updates.



3. Product & Supplier Coordination



* Coordinate with our China-based sourcing and fulfillment partners.

* Monitor product availability and inventory information.

* Help ensure supplier products are correctly mapped to Shopify variants.

* Identify discrepancies in product information or fulfillment processes.

* Assist with establishing reliable product onboarding and order-processing workflows.



4. Process Improvement & SOPs



* Create and maintain standard operating procedures.

* Develop checklists for product uploads, website QA, and order processing.

* Identify repetitive tasks that can be automated or delegated.

* Use AI tools to improve operational efficiency.

* Recommend improvements to workflows and team coordination.



5. Launch Readiness & Quality Control



* Track launch requirements across both brands.

* Ensure product pages, policies, navigation, and checkout are functioning correctly.

* Coordinate final website testing.

* Flag operational risks before they affect customers.

* Help establish processes for handling orders, returns, and customer issues.



Requirements



Must Have



* At least 2 years of hands-on Shopify experience.

* Experience managing e-commerce operations or Shopify projects.

* Strong project-management and organizational skills.

* Experience coordinating freelancers, developers, or remote teams.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Ability to work independently and proactively solve problems.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Comfortable using Google Workspace and project-management tools.

* Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT.



Preferred



* Experience managing multiple Shopify stores.

* Experience with dropshipping or cross-border e-commerce.

* Familiarity with product imports and variant mapping.

* Experience working with overseas suppliers or fulfillment partners.

* Experience creating SOPs and improving workflows.

* Experience in fashion, jewelry, or lifestyle e-commerce.



Working Arrangement



* Fully remote.

* Part-time, approximately 15–20 hours per week.

* Flexible working hours, with some overlap with US Pacific Time.

* Initial two-week paid trial.

* Potential for a long-term working relationship and increased responsibilities.



What Success Looks Like



Within your first 30 days, you should be able to:



* Independently coordinate our existing Shopify contractors.

* Maintain an organized task-management system across both brands.

* Ensure product listings and website updates are accurate.

* Track and resolve outstanding website issues.

* Coordinate effectively with our China-based fulfillment team.

* Establish clear SOPs for recurring operations.

* Provide concise daily updates on progress, blockers, and next steps.



Our goal is simple: We want someone who takes ownership and gets things done, rather than waiting to be told what to do next.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A brief introduction and summary of your Shopify experience.

2. Examples of Shopify stores or e-commerce projects you’ve managed.

3. Your experience coordinating developers, freelancers, or remote teams.

4. An example of a problem you identified and solved independently.

5. Your hourly rate and weekly availability.



Screening Question:



Imagine you’re managing two Shopify stores with an external developer, a product upload assistant, and a fulfillment partner in China. Several product pages have incorrect variants, the developer has unfinished website fixes, and the stores are preparing to launch.



How would you organize the work, prioritize tasks, and ensure everything gets completed?



Please describe your approach in a few sentences.

title: Real Estate Cold Caller & Appointment Setter
description:
Looking for a remote appointment setter to help me find properties to purchase throughout the U.S. You’ll call owners whose properties may not be listed for sale, introduce yourself on my behalf, and ask whether they’d be open to an unsolicited offer. When an owner is interested, you’ll learn a little about the property and schedule a conversation with me.



I’m looking for someone who enjoys talking with people and follows through on what they say. If an owner tells you, “Call me after my tenant’s lease is up in March,” I want to be confident you’ll make that call in March and remember where the conversation left off.



**What you’ll do**



- Make outbound calls to property owners, explain why you’re calling, and find out whether they’d consider selling.

- Ask natural follow-up questions. Confirm the property address and who makes the selling decision. Learn what the owner is willing to share about occupancy, condition, major repairs, timing, and price expectations. For multifamily properties, details such as unit count, vacancies, and current rents help me evaluate a potential offer.

- Book interested owners directly on my calendar. Make sure they know they’ll be speaking with a potential buyer, confirm the time and best callback number, and send me a short summary before the appointment. I handle pricing, offers, and negotiations.

- Manage each prospect in our CRM. Record the outcome of every conversation, schedule agreed callbacks, confirm upcoming appointments, and reconnect after missed calls. Promptly record and honor requests to stop calling.



**What I’m looking for**



- Experience in outbound calling, appointment setting, or phone-based sales. Experience speaking with U.S. property owners is a plus.

- Clear spoken English, strong listening skills, and the judgment to ask another question or politely end a call.

- Accurate written notes and experience using a CRM and an online calendar.

- Reliable internet, a clear-sounding headset, a quiet place to work, and availability to call during agreed U.S. Central Time hours.



**How to apply**



Send a brief summary of your relevant experience, the calling or CRM tools you’ve used, your availability in U.S. Central Time, and your expected hourly rate in USD.



Please also include a **45–60 second voice recording**. Imagine you’ve just introduced yourself and a property owner replies, *“I hadn’t planned on selling, but I’d listen if the price made sense. What are you offering?”* Respond as you would on a live call. I’d like to hear how you handle the question and what you’d ask next.

title: Experienced Travel Planner — Group Itineraries & Proposals
description:
Vohana LLC is a B2B travel company that works with travel industry partners to plan trips for their clients, including medium to large groups. We’re looking for an experienced travel planner to turn partner briefs into realistic itineraries and polished proposals. You’ll also manage our Fora account once it’s set up, participate in the community, and help identify new leads for Vohana.



What you’ll do



- Build day-by-day itineraries around each group’s size, interests, dates, budget, and preferred pace.

- Research hotels, transportation, tours, and activities. Verify pricing, availability, group capacity, and travel times.

- Prepare proposals that clearly explain the itinerary, pricing, and what’s included. Review details for accuracy and revise drafts based on feedback from our team and travel partners.

- Manage Vohana’s Fora account. Participate regularly in community discussions, build relationships with other members, and look for opportunities where Vohana can help with group travel. Track promising leads and coordinate follow-up with our team.



Experience and skills



Prior professional travel planning experience is required.** You should have built multi-day itineraries and prepared travel proposals or quotes for clients. Experience working with travel advisors, agencies, or tour operators and planning trips for medium to large groups is especially valuable.



Itinerary planning and logistics.- Build realistic schedules that account for group transfers, activity timing, and how long it takes to move a group between stops.



Travel research and budgeting.- Compare options, verify costs and capacity, and recommend choices that fit the group’s needs and budget.



Proposal writing.- Present the itinerary, pricing, and inclusions clearly so our partners can review and share the proposal with their clients.



Our team uses -Travefy, Claude, ChatGPT, Airtable, Google Workspace (including Google Chat), and GoHighLevel (GHL)**. Familiarity with any of these tools is a plus, and experience with similar platforms is welcome. Experience with Fora, advisor communities, or relationship-based lead generation is also welcome.



- Air ticketing experience is a plus-  and could be useful as we expand our services.



## How to apply



Send your résumé or a short introduction and list your relevant travel planning experience. For each role or project you highlight, include the company, agency, or freelance practice you worked with, the dates, the destinations and typical group sizes you handled, and the tools you used. If you have experience with Fora, sourcing leads through an advisor community, or air ticketing, briefly describe what you personally handled.



Please answer these three questions using real projects. You may use the same trip for all three answers if it fits.



1. **What’s one multi-day group itinerary you helped build?** Include the destination, number of travelers, number of days, who you prepared it for, and which parts you personally planned or wrote.

2. **What’s one logistical challenge you handled on a group trip?** Describe the issue, such as hotel capacity, coach transfers, or activity limits, and explain what you personally changed in the itinerary and why.

3. **What did you personally contribute to a group travel proposal or quote?** Include the group size, who received the proposal, which parts you wrote or priced, and how you checked that the pricing and inclusions matched the itinerary.



If you have an itinerary or proposal sample you’re allowed to share, please remove client details before including it.

description:
Job Overview

We run several short-form video accounts and need one reliable person to post pre-made videos on a fixed daily schedule. You do not create or edit videos. You control a company phone from your computer and follow a step-by-step guide. Each post takes about 5-10 minutes.



Pay

$1.00 per video posted (one video that goes to several platforms counts as one video). 12 videos a day, 7 days a week, about $360/month. Paid weekly after your first week. $30 bonus each week for posting every video on time, bringing possible monthly pay to $480. Ability for pay to raise over time. Long-term work strongly desired.



IMPORTANT: Schedule

Posts go out about every 2 hours, from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM US Eastern Time, every day including weekends. That is about 9:00 PM to 11:00 AM Manila time right now. The work itself is short, but you need to be at your computer for each slot. Please apply only if you can keep this schedule reliably.



Exact US Eastern posting times:

- 8:00 AM, 10:00 AM, 12:00 PM, 2:00 PM, 4:00 PM, 6:00 PM, 8:00 PM, 10:00 PM

title: Remote Senior MSP IT Support Engineer (L2/L3) — Vancouver hours
description:
We are a managed IT provider in Vancouver, Canada, looking for a full-time L2/L3 technician who wants to stay and grow with us. You will speak with clients, carry issues through to a verified fix, improve the tools behind the work, and help us build the next stage of our technical team.



We support approximately 20 customer organizations, 200–250 users and 20 servers. You will get to know their environments and have room to make a lasting impact. Our plan is to settle the first new technician into our clients and workflows, then add a second as the business grows. We would value someone who wants to help shape the team's standards and support new colleagues over time.



This is a fully remote role for applicants residing in the Philippines. No relocation to Canada is required. You must be able to work the stated Vancouver hours.



What you'll do



- Own client calls,
 and Autotask tickets from first response through verified resolution. Respond to service
 the same business day, keep clients informed and leave notes another technician can use.

- Solve everyday and complex MSP issues across workstations, printers, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Windows Server, Active Directory, Entra ID, Azure, Private Cloud, DNS/DHCP, networks and backups.

- Administer our deployed Kaseya stack, especially Autotask PSA, Datto RMM and IT Glue. Work across our security and backup toolset, including Dark Web ID, EDR, AV, BullPhish, SaaSAlerts, MDR, RocketCyber, INKY, Graphus, Datto Backup and Unified Backup. Improve Autotask queues, workflows and templates; build or adjust Datto RMM monitoring, patching, jobs, policies and automation with testing, approval and rollback.

- Handle basic business firewall work, including rules, VPN, NAT and logs, on Meraki or another platform. Coordinate alerts, escalations and ticket ownership with our NOC and SOC. Put security into each decision.

- Use lighter support periods for assigned projects, documentation and service improvements. Look for repeatable work that can be made faster and more reliable through safe Autotask or Datto RMM automation, then test and measure the result. You will have a full-time mix of client support and planned improvement work.

- Use approved AI tools to help with diagnosis, research, scripting, documentation and routine work. Spot practical opportunities to save time while protecting client information, checking AI output against source systems and keeping a person accountable for each ticket and change.



What you bring



- Strong hands-on L2 MSP experience, sound L3 judgment, and a track record of owning issues through a verified outcome.

- Direct experience administering Autotask PSA, Datto RMM and IT Glue. Experience with several of the listed security and backup products, plus the ability to learn the rest. We will ask which workflows, templates, policies or automations you personally changed and tested.

- Working experience in both Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace; practical Windows Server, identity, Azure/Private Cloud, networking and security skills. Meraki experience is welcome. Solid firewall fundamentals on another business platform and a clear ability to learn Meraki also count.

- Careful security judgment in everyday support: protect client data, use least privilege and MFA, recognize suspicious activity, escalate i
 promptly, and follow approval, test and rollback steps before changing systems.

- Ability to use AI tools responsibly in technical work and interest in finding efficiencies through automation or AI. Bring an example of a task you improved, what you automated or used AI for, how much time or rework it saved, and how you verified the result.

- Excellent spoken and written English for frequent live client calls, clear updates and dependable follow-through. You enjoy learning, sharing knowledge and improving how a team works.

- A reliable work computer, quiet space, independent backup internet and backup power. You are willing to follow our written security and work-profile policies; we will agree on device-management terms before installing tools on a personal computer.

- Availability Monday–Friday, 7:30 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Vancouver local time, five days a week. Vancouver local time is UTC−7 year-round. Paid hours and breaks within the coverage window will be agreed before an offer.



An annual performance bonus may be available based on results, contribution to the business's growth and reliable ownership of the role, under written terms agreed before an offer. Benefits, equipment, overtime, holiday coverage, engagement structure and compensation will be discussed with finalists.



Apply

title: Remote Office Manager | Full-Time | Customer Service & Operations
description:
We're looking for someone who wants to become the person an owner can trust to run the office. 



Bugs Beware is a growing pest control company in Wisconsin, and we're hiring our first dedicated office team member.



  The right person will eventually own most of the day-to-day office operation: taking care of customers, managing the schedule, keeping technicians organized, following up on payments and leads, and making sure things don't fall through the cracks.  



You'll work directly with the owner and learn how the entire business operates.   We're much more interested in finding someone who is sharp, dependable, organized, great with people, and learns quickly than someone who checks every technical box on day one.  If you're the type of person who naturally takes ownership and figures things out, keep reading.



   THE JOB

  You'll become the main point person for the day-to-day office side of the business.  You'll own things like: 

- Answering customer calls, texts, and
s

 - Handling customer questions, concerns, and service issues

 - Scheduling and rescheduling services

 - Coordinating technician schedules and routes 

- Following up with leads and prospective customers 

- Following up on failed and overdue payments 

- Helping customers with billing questions

 - Keeping customer accounts, notes, and records accurate

 - Making sure follow-ups and important tasks don't get missed 

- Helping with customer retention and review requests 

- Keeping company systems and information organized

 - Assisting with basic QuickBooks tasks and financial admin

 - Helping with basic social media posting and marketing tasks

 - Taking on additional office responsibilities as you learn the business



  The goal isn't for you to stay an assistant forever.   The goal is for you to learn the business well enough that the owner can increasingly hand you responsibilities and trust that they're handled.



   YO

U  You'll probably be a great fit If:

 - You speak and write excellent English

 - You're confident and professional on the phone

 - You're extremely organized 

- You're tech-savvy and learn new software quickly 

- You take ownership without needing constant follow-up 

- You notice when something is wrong and try to solve it 

- You're comfortable juggling multiple priorities

 - You're comfortable working with numbers and basic financial information

 - You communicate quickly and clearly 

- You're dependable — if you say you'll do something, it gets done 

- You enjoy creating order and keeping things organized 

- You want a long-term position where you can earn more responsibility over time  



We're looking for someone who can eventually hear: "Can you handle this?" …and make the owner's life easier from there.   



EXPERIENCE

  You should have previous experience in customer service, office administration, operations, or a similar role.



  Experience with any of the following is a bonus: 

- QuickBooks / QuickBooks Online 

- Bookkeeping or transaction categorization

 - Pest control or another home-service business 

- Dispatching or route scheduling

 - Accounts receivable / collections 

- GorillaDesk - Customer retention 

- Sales follow-up 

- Social media posting

 - Working directly with a small-business owner  



QuickBooks experience is NOT required.   If you're comfortable with numbers, tech-savvy, and willing to learn, we can train you on the QuickBooks responsibilities you'll need for this role.   We'd rather hire an exceptional office manager who can learn QuickBooks than an exceptional bookkeeper who isn't great at running an office. 



   THE DEAL

 - Full-time

 - Remote

 - Must be available during Central Time business hours 

- $900–$1,200 USD/month depending on experience

 - Performance bonuses

 - Paid training

 - Long-term position 

- Opportunity for increased responsibility and compensation as the company grows   



You'll also need reliable high-speed internet, a dependable computer with webcam, and a quiet place to take customer calls.   



WHY THIS OPPORTUNITY IS DIFFERENT

  You'll be the first dedicated office hire atBugs Beware Pest Patrol. That means you won't be one of 30 assistants doing one tiny piece of the operation.  You'll work directly with the owner, learn how the company works, and have the opportunity to become a major part of the business as it grows.



  For the right person, this can become much more than a typical VA position.   We care less about having the perfect resume and more about finding someone who is smart, reliable, coachable, and takes ownership. 



  HOW TO APPLY

  Please send:

  1. Your resume 

 2. A NEW 3–5 minute Loom video made specifically for this application answering these questions: 

 - Give us a quick introduction to yourself. 

- Tell us about the most similar role you've had. What were you personally responsible for, and what could your manager trust you to handle without constantly following up with you? 

- Tell us about a time you had several important things happen at once. How did you d
 what to handle first and make sure nothing got missed?

 - Imagine the owner is out in the field and three things happen at the same time: An upset customer calls, A technician has a scheduling problem, Several overdue customer payments need follow-up. Walk us through exactly what you would do. 

- What experience do you have with QuickBooks, bookkeeping, social media, CRMs, or other business software? It's completely okay if you haven't used all of these. Tell us what you've used and how you normally learn a new system. 

- Why do you believe you'd be a great first office hire for a small business where you'll be expected to take more ownership over time?



  Important: Generic or previously recorded Loom videos will not be considered.  



To show us you read the entire post, start your application with: "Bugs Beware is #1."

The successful candidate will be strategic, responsive, and comfortable working directly with clients and senior attorneys.

• Prepare, serve, and respond to interrogatories, requests for production, and requests for admission, and manage document productions.

• Draft, argue, and oppose motions, including motions to dismiss, motions to compel, and motions for summary judgment.

• Prepare for, take, and defend depositions.

• Develop case strategy, assess risk and exposure, and advise clients on litigation options and settlement.

• Represent clients in hearings, mediations, and settlement negotiations.

• Support senior attorneys with trial preparation and trial, including witness preparation, exhibits, and pretrial filings.

• Assist with post-judgment and appellate matters, including briefs and enforcement.

• Conduct legal research and prepare correspondence, memoranda, and other legal documents.

• Communicate directly with clients to gather information, provide updates, and respond to legal questions.

• Manage assigned matters from opening through resolution while meeting deadlines and maintaining high-quality work.

• At least three years of civil litigation experience through a law firm or in-house legal department.

• Experience with pleadings, discovery, motion practice, depositions, and case management from intake through resolution.

• Prior experience working with a U.S.-based company or law firm.

• Strong legal research, analytical, writing, oral advocacy, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills and the ability to work professionally with clients.

• Ability to work independently, collaborate with a remote team, and manage multiple matters and deadlines.

• A stable work history demonstrating meaningful tenure and professional growth.

Preferred Qualifications

• Trial, arbitration, or appellate experience.

• Admission to practice in U.S. federal courts.

What We Offer

• Remote work within an established virtual-work environment.

• The opportunity to work closely with experienced litigation attorneys.

• Hands-on exposure to all stages of civil litigation, from case evaluation through trial and appeal.

Compensation & Career Path:



Starting Rate: We start out with a 7-10 day trial period which is paid $8 per approved lead. Once you prove to have strong sourcing skills, pay transitions to starting at $3 per hour. Potential for increasing with experience.



Performance Bonuses: In addition to your base hourly pay, you can earn extra cash bonuses based on the quality, profitability, and volume of approved leads you submit.



Growth & Raises: We are looking for someone to grow with us. You will have opportunities for regular performance-based pay raises and promotion into a Lead Sourcer or Purchasing Manager role as our team scales.

Your primary focus is finding profitable, fast-moving products for us to sell on Amazon. You must have strong communication skills.



Daily Sourcing: Spend your shift conducting Online Arbitrage (OA) and/or Wholesale product research using SellerAmp (SAS), Keepa, and storefront stalking techniques.



Lead Qualification: Verify every product against our strict profitability, ROI, BSR (Best Sellers Rank), IP complaint, and hazmat criteria before submitting.



End-of-Shift Deliverable: At the end of every single 8-hour shift, you are expected to submit 3-4 fully vetted, profitable product leads into our shared Google Sheet tracker along with a brief end-of-day summary of your progress.



Qualifications: Experienced VAs Only. At least 1 year preferred.



Proven Experience: Must have prior hands-on experience as an Amazon Product Sourcing VA. Please do not apply if you have zero sourcing experience—we are scaling quickly and cannot train beginners from scratch.

title: Xactimate Estimator
description:
# Full-Time Xactimate Estimator — Remote (Philippines)

**Salary: $1,800–$2,600 USD per Month + Performance Bonuses**



**Full-Time | 40 Hours per Week | U.S. Eastern Business Hours | Dedicated Position**



### About American Restoration



American Restoration Service Inc. is an established U.S.-based restoration company operating since 2007. We specialize in insurance reconstruction, water damage, fire damage, mold remediation, and property restoration.



We are seeking a dependable, detail-oriented Xactimate Estimator to join our team on a long-term basis.



**We value honesty, reliability, and a willingness to learn just as much as experience.**



We understand that not every estimator has experience in every area of restoration. Some applicants specialize in mitigation, others in reconstruction, and others in sketching or estimate preparation.



That's perfectly acceptable.



We would rather hire someone who accurately represents their abilities and is willing to improve than someone who exaggerates their qualifications.



### Compensation and Benefits



- $1,800–$2,600 USD monthly, depending on verified skills and experience

- Weekly payments through Gusto

- Performance-based bonuses

- Opportunities for salary increases as skills develop

- Long-term, stable work with an established U.S. company

- Training and professional development

- Direct communication with company management

- Fully remote, work-from-home position

- Monday–Friday schedule with no regular weekend requirements



### Work Schedule



This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position.



Applicants must be available during U.S. Eastern business hours, generally between 9:00 AM and 6:00 PM Eastern Time, depending on their assigned shift.



This requires overnight working hours in the Philippines.



**Important: Dedicated Working Hours Required**



We are hiring a dedicated team member, not someone seeking to work multiple jobs simultaneously.



During scheduled working hours, employees and contractors must devote their professional time and attention exclusively to American Restoration.



Working another job, performing freelance assignments, attending other employers' meetings, or completing work for another client during assigned American Restoration hours is not permitted.



Applicants must disclose any existing professional commitments that could conflict with this schedule.



Outside employment is not automatically prohibited, provided it does not overlap with assigned hours, create a conflict of interest, or interfere with performance.



Honesty about existing commitments is essential.



### Job Responsibilities



Depending on experience and demonstrated skills, responsibilities may include:



- Prepare accurate Xactimate estimates for insurance restoration projects

- Create and modify Xactimate sketches

- Develop reconstruction estimates

- Review photographs, field measurements, scope sheets, and project documentation

- Identify missing scope items and request additional information

- Apply appropriate estimating line items, quantities, and pricing

- Prepare estimate documentation for insurance carrier submission

- Assist with supplements, estimate revisions, and carrier responses

- Maintain organized project documentation

- Communicate with field supervisors, project managers, and other team members

- Follow established company estimating and documentation procedures

- Learn and use American Restoration's internal software and project management systems



### Experience and Qualifications



Applicants should have some practical experience with Xactimate or insurance restoration estimating.



**You do not need to be an expert in every category to apply.**



We are open to candidates who have a strong foundation in certain areas and are willing to receive training in others.



We are particularly interested in applicants who demonstrate:



- Genuine hands-on Xactimate experience

- Strong attention to detail

- Ability to follow written instructions

- Good written and verbal English

- Dependability and consistent attendance

- Willingness to ask questions when something is unclear

- Ability to work independently and communicate proactively

- Reliable internet and a suitable home office

- Ability to work scheduled U.S. business hours



### Be Honest About Your Actual Experience



We evaluate applicants based on demonstrated abilities, not just job titles or years of experience.



For example:



If you can create Xactimate sketches but have limited experience writing complete reconstruction estimates, tell us.



If you have experience entering estimates from prepared scope sheets but have never independently developed a scope, tell us.



If you understand mitigation estimating but need training in fire damage or reconstruction, tell us.



**We are willing to train the right person. We are not willing to hire someone who misrepresents their experience.**



### Required Skills Self-Assessment



When applying, please evaluate your experience in each category using the following scale:



- **Independent:** I can complete this work accurately without assistance.

- **Some Experience:** I have performed this work but occasionally need guidance.

- **Training Needed:** I understand the basics but require training.

- **No Experience:** I have not performed this work.



Please rate yourself in these areas:



1. Xactimate sketching and room measurements

2. Preparing estimates from completed scope sheets

3. Developing estimates independently from photos and documentation

4. Water mitigation estimating

5. Reconstruction and repair estimating

6. Fire damage estimating

7. Mold remediation estimating

8. Selecting appropriate Xactimate line items and quantities

9. Preparing estimate supplements and revisions

10. Understanding U.S. insurance carrier estimating requirements



There is no expectation that applicants will rate themselves as independent in every area.



### Our Hiring Process



Qualified applicants may be asked to complete a practical, time-limited Xactimate estimating assessment using sample project documentation.



The purpose is to verify actual experience, identify training needs, and determine the appropriate starting salary.



We do not expect perfection. We do expect applicants to accurately represent their abilities and complete assessments without unauthorized assistance.



### How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your current résumé

2. A brief summary of your Xactimate experience

3. Your completed skills self-assessment

4. One or two sample estimates, if available, with all customer information removed

5. Your expected monthly salary in USD

6. Confirmation that you can work full-time U.S. Eastern business hours without overlapping professional commitments



**Final Question:**



Why are you looking for a long-term, dedicated position with one company, and what areas of Xactimate estimating would you most like to improve?



We are looking for someone who wants to become a valuable, trusted member of our team.



We offer competitive compensation, professional growth, and a stable working relationship in return for honesty, consistency, and quality work.

title: TikTok News Editor — Memes & B-Roll
description:
# TikTok News Editor — Memes & B-Roll



**PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING**



**Your FIRST message must include your COMPLETED editing assessment.**



Please do not message me just saying "I'm interested," "I want to apply," or sending only your resume.



The full job description, editing examples, raw footage, and assessment instructions are provided below.



**I am only reviewing applications that include the completed assessment.** You do not need to ask for permission or wait for an invitation to start.



## Who I'm Looking For



I'm looking for a creative short-form video editor who understands **American internet humor, TikTok/YouTube news commentary, memes, and how to find the EXACT clips that match what someone is talking about.**



I'm not looking for someone who only cuts pauses and adds captions.



I need someone who can listen to my commentary, understand the story, independently research the right footage, and make creative editing decisions.



For example, if I'm talking about an affiliate commission issue, I want the actual commission screen recording—not a random company logo.



If I'm discussing a creator's AI tool, I want that creator's original video—not generic AI footage.



**The ability to find the right visuals and understand comedic timing is the most important part of this job.**



## About the Job



I'm a TikTok Shop affiliate who has generated nearly $2 million in GMV over approximately the past year.



I'm building a daily series called **TikTok Shop Affiliate News**, covering three interesting stories about TikTok Shop, creators, affiliate commissions, products, platform updates, and AI tools.



My workflow is simple:



**I research and record → You handle the entire edit → I review and post.**



Your responsibilities include:



1. Editing my raw talking-head footage into complete episodes.

2. Independently finding original TikTok videos, articles, screenshots, screen recordings, and relevant memes.

3. Creating professional vertical split-screen videos with supporting footage on top and me talking on the bottom.

4. Adding well-timed humor, captions, headlines, zooms, and transitions.

5. Delivering polished, accurate videos without needing instructions for every individual clip.



This is an **ongoing paid position**, with at least one video per day and occasionally two or three.

The assessment is unpaid and voluntary and is used only for hiring evaluation unless we separately agree otherwise.



You must recreate the **ENTIRE episode**, not a short sample. This includes the opening, all three stories, and the closing.



All raw footage and supporting materials are linked inside the PDF.



**Complete the assessment BEFORE sending your first message.**



## How to Apply

1. **Completed assessment video** — a Google Drive link or another accessible video link.

2. **Your three best previous editing projects** — links to work you've personally edited.

3. **Your expected rate** — per finished video or monthly.

4. **Your availability** — working hours, time zone, and turnaround for one to three videos per day.

5. **Your editing software and relevant experience.**

6. **Your source links** — the main original clips and articles you used in the assessment.



Make sure your links can be opened without requesting access.



## Contact Me



**
:** hennyg1



**WhatsApp:** 
Contact me on ONE of these platforms and send your complete application in your first message.



**IMPORTANT: Messages that only say "I'm interested," "Can I apply?" or "Please send the assessment" will not be reviewed. Everything you need is already in the PDF.**



I'm looking forward to seeing what you can create!

family is published without a signed release on file, and we never include

identifiable details beyond what has been consented to.



● Compliance. For some of the work: Our clinicians follow the IBLCE Code of Professional Conduct and MilkWise which honors the WHO International Code of Marketing of Breast-milk Substitutes. In practice: no infant formula, bottle, or pacifier brands in our content, no claims about products or outcomes that clinical review hasn't approved, and no editing that changes the meaning of what a clinician said. You won't just be cutting videos: you will be the "retention master." We need someone who knows how to find the funniest, most satisfying, or most engaging moments in a long video and edit them in a way that keeps viewers hooked from the first second.



What You'll Be Doing:

- Watch through long-form videos/raw footage to find the best "golden" moments.

- Edit and repurpose these clips into a fast-paced, high-retention short-form videos(under 60 seconds).

- Incorporate engaging visual effects, sound effects, B-roll, and background music to maximize audience retention.

- Keep up with current TikTok, Reel, and Shorts trends and apply them to our content.

- Deliver a consistent quota of clips per week/day.



What We're Looking For:

- Experience: Proven experience in editing short-form content. You must know what makes a video go viral (hooks, pacing).

- Tools: Proficient in Adobe Premier Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve.

- Creative Eye: You have a great sense of comedic timing, pacing, and storytelling.



Perks of Joining Us:

- 100% Work-From-Home

- Flexible working hours (Output Based)

- Be part of a massive, fun, and creative global brand.

- Room for growth and long-term employment.



How to Apply:

If you think you are the perfect fit for the Slimeatory team, please send us a message with the following:



1. Change the subject line to: "Slime Clipper: [Your Name]" (This shows us you pay attention to detail)

2. A brief introduction about yourself and your experience.

3. CRITICAL: A link to your portfolio or Google Drive folder containing examples of short-form clips you have edited (TikTok/Reel/Shorts).



Applications without a portfolio of short-form clips will not be entertained.

title: Cinematic Video Editor for Tourism and Corporate Content
description:
ARK Media is a cinematic video production company based in Kelowna, BC. We produce commercial content for national brands, tourism boards, and agencies across Canada. Our work is story-driven and held to a high visual standard, branded short films, not talking head instagram reels.



Website: 

Please actually watch our work before applying. We can tell when you haven't.



The Role

We're hiring a full-time remote Video Editor to join our small team, long-term. We want you to grow with us. There's plenty of room for raises, training, on-going learning and support and increased responsibility in our organization. We are NOT looking for another freelancer to do our work on the side.



You'll be editing commercial deliverables in DaVinci Resolve: Brand films, tourism campaigns, social cutdowns and behind-the-scenes content. Our Lead Editor and Videographer/Editor will bring you into the workflow and hand off projects as you ramp up.



We are NOT looking for someone who cuts to the beat and drops in transitions. We're looking for an editor with taste, someone who understands pacing, restraint, emotional rhythm, and how to let a shot breathe.



What You'll Do

- Edit long-form commercial pieces (60s–5min brand films, tourism videos, case studies)

- Edit short-form social content (15s–60s Reels, TikToks, Shorts) from provided footage and briefs

- Sync, organize, and manage media in DaVinci Resolve / Blackmagic Cloud

- Colour correction and grading

- Sound design and music sync: clean mixes, tasteful SFX, no cheese

- Light motion graphics (lower thirds, end cards, simple type animation)



Compensation:

2K USD / Month

Benefits

Flexible work schedule

On going training

Lots of growth opportunity



Must-Haves

- 5+ years editing professional commercial or branded content

- Expert in DaVinci Resolve Studio - this is where you'll work

- Expert ability to put a coherent and logical story together from hours of interviews.

- Strong sense of pacing and rhythm. Your edits should feel intentional, not templated

- Excellent written and spoken English for communication with our team and clients

- Stable high-speed internet capable of large proxy files and cloud workflows

- Reliable computer capable of editing 4K footage

- A few hours of weekly live overlap with Pacific Time (we're flexible, but calls need to happen)



Nice-to-Haves:

Motion design in After Effects or Fusion

Experience editing for tourism, lifestyle, or outdoor brands

Photography or cinematography background, you understand what we shot and why



How to Apply:

Read this section carefully. We receive a lot of templated applications and throw them out immediately. If any of these pieces are missing or clearly recycled, we won't respond. We want genuine effort and time put into our application.



1. A selfie video, recorded specifically for this application. Not a reused intro. Tell us who you are, and, this is the part that matters, tell us which piece of content on our website stood out to you and why. One minute is plenty.



2. Your reel, plus links to three full project examples. No talking head, captioned instagram reels. Full pieces you've edited, so we can see pacing and structure across a whole story. Tell us what you did on each one (some applicants send team reels and take credit for everything).



3. Your resume.



4. Computer specs and internet speed test results.



5. Your availability and confirmation that you're ready to work 40 hours a week Monday through Friday.



Process

Shortlisted applicants will be asked to edit a, paid, sample video. We choose one editor from the sample round. We read every application personally and will get back to you.
