title: Experienced ClickUp Specialist | Workspace Architecture, Systems & Automation
description:
We are an established, growing U.S.-based consumer products company seeking an experienced ClickUp Specialist / Systems Architect to help restructure, optimize, and expand our existing ClickUp workspace.



We're looking for a highly skilled, hands-on professional with ideally 3–7+ years of ClickUp experience, who has successfully built and managed comprehensive ClickUp systems for businesses with multiple departments, teams, and workflows.



About the Project



We've been using ClickUp for several years and are committed to making it our primary platform for managing our company's operations, departments, projects, and internal organization.



Our original workspace was developed internally as our business grew. While we've established a solid foundation and worked with consultants to improve certain areas, we believe there's significant opportunity to restructure, streamline, and expand the system.



We're now looking for someone who can take a more active, hands-on role in building and managing the platform correctly.



We are not looking for someone who only provides consulting advice. We want someone who can plan, build, implement, organize, document, and continuously improve our ClickUp workspace.



Key Responsibilities



Audit and evaluate our existing ClickUp workspace.



Restructure Spaces, Folders, Lists, tasks, and workflows.



Build scalable systems for multiple departments and business functions.



Develop custom fields, statuses, templates, dashboards, and automations.



Improve task management, delegation, reporting, and team accountability.



Create standardized workflows and operating procedures.



Recommend and implement integrations where appropriate.



Eliminate unnecessary complexity, duplication, and inefficient workflows.



Assist with team onboarding, training, and ClickUp best practices.



Provide ongoing implementation and optimization support.



Ideal Candidate



Ideally 3–7+ years of hands-on ClickUp experience.



Proven history building and improving ClickUp workspaces for established companies.



Advanced knowledge of ClickUp's structure, features, dashboards, automations, and integrations.



Experience supporting businesses with multiple departments.



Excellent written and spoken English.



Strong organizational and problem-solving skills.



Able to work independently and take ownership of assigned projects.



Reliable computer, internet connection, and professional remote working environment.



Availability for occasional virtual meetings during U.S. business hours.



ClickUp certifications and previous consulting or implementation experience are a plus.



Compensation & Opportunity



Remote, hourly contractor position.



International applicants welcome.



Competitive hourly compensation based on experience and qualifications.



Flexible working hours with some U.S. time-zone overlap.



Initial project-based engagement with potential for long-term collaboration.



We're interested in building a reliable, long-term relationship with someone who can grow alongside our company.



Required Application Information



Please submit ALL of the following with your initial application. Incomplete applications may not be considered.



1. Personal Introduction



Tell us a little about yourself, where you're located, your professional background, and how long you've been working with ClickUp.



2. ClickUp Experience



Describe your experience with ClickUp, including the types of businesses you've worked with, workspace structures you've built, and your strongest technical capabilities.



3. Previous Work Examples



Share any relevant examples, screenshots, or portfolio materials demonstrating ClickUp environments you've developed. Please exclude confidential client information.



4. Personal Video Introduction & Workstation Walkthrough — REQUIRED



Please record a 2–4-minute video using Loom, Zoom recording, or a similar tool.



Your video should include:



Face-to-camera introduction: Introduce yourself naturally in English. Tell us about your background, ClickUp experience, and why you're interested in this opportunity.



Workstation walkthrough: Show us your actual computer setup, including your monitor(s), computer, microphone/headset, and general workspace. Tell us what type of computer you use, including your operating system and basic specifications. Show the results of a recent speed test from Speedtest.net, including download speed, upload speed, and ping.



Communication: Explain how you typically communicate with clients, manage deadlines, and provide updates on ongoing projects.



We're requesting this video to better understand each applicant's communication style, English proficiency for collaborative work, technical setup, and readiness for a remote working relationship.



Please use your normal speaking voice without AI voiceovers or prerecorded promotional presentations. Professional video production is not necessary.



5. Rate & Availability



Please confirm your requested hourly rate in USD, estimated hours available per week, country, time zone, and ability to overlap with U.S. Central Time business hours.



6. Attention-to-Detail Requirement



To confirm you've read this posting carefully, please begin your application with the exact phrase:



"ClickUp Built Right"



Our Hiring & Selection Process



We are taking a structured approach to finding the right long-term professional.



Round 1 — Application Review

title: Supply Chain Manager (Amazon & Ecommerce)
description:
About us

Swooc Games is a growing e-commerce brand selling indoor and outdoor games across Amazon, Walmart, Target, and many other ecommerce retailers. We're a small, lean team that runs on Google Workspace and in-house tools we build ourselves — sales dashboards, ad automation, marketplace alerts and more. We move fast, automate whatever we can, and care a lot about knowing our real numbers.



The role

We're looking for a hands-on Supply Chain Manager to own the flow of inventory from our overseas factories all the way to the customer. You'll manage purchase orders with our suppliers in China, ocean freight and container imports, our 3PL in the US, and replenishment into Amazon FBA and our other channels. Just as important, you'll make sure every unit's true landed cost is captured quickly and accurately so we know our profit per SKU without waiting on month-end.



This is a high-ownership role for someone who likes spreadsheets and logistics equally, and who will look at a manual process and ask how to make it faster.



What you'll do

• Purchasing & suppliers: Place and track POs with our China-based manufacturers; manage lead times, production schedules, quality and payment milestones; keep our supply order tracking up to date.

• International freight & import: Coordinate container shipments from China to the U.S. — forwarders, customs, duties and delivery. Understand incoterms (DDP, FOB, etc.) and what each means for our costs.

• 3PL management: Be the main point of contact with our Reno 3PL, which receives our containers, fulfills orders for our non-Amazon channels, and ships replenishment into FBA. Hold them accountable on receiving accuracy, turnaround and billing.

• Amazon FBA inbound: Plan and create FBA shipments, book LTL freight (we use Uber Freight), and minimize total inbound cost by weighing Amazon placement fees against freight — single vs. multi-fulfillment-center splits, and options like Amazon Global Logistics (AGL).

• Order planning: Plan orders by SKU based on inventory forecast, set reorder points, and keep us in stock without overordering. 

• Landed cost & COGS: Own accurate landed cost per SKU (product, freight, duties, 3PL and Amazon inbound fees), reconciled against POs and shipment invoices, and feed it into our profit-per-SKU reporting.

• Process & systems: Coordinate with inhouse team to improve and automate our supply chain workflows in Google Sheets and our in-house apps; work with the team on tools that pull data from Amazon's Selling Partner API and BigQuery.



What we're looking for

• 3+ years in supply chain, operations or logistics for a consumer products or e-commerce brand.

• Direct experience importing from China (or Asia) by ocean container, including working with factories and freight forwarders.

• Very strong working knowledge of Amazon FBA inbound: shipment creation, case packs, placement fees, and Seller Central inventory tools.

• Experience managing a 3PL relationship.

• Very strong Google Sheets / Excel skills — you're comfortable building and maintaining trackers and cost models.

• Comfort with landed cost, COGS and can reconcile invoices back to POs.

• Clear, proactive communicator who works well remotely and across time zones.



Details

• Type:  Full Time (40hrs per week)

• Pay: $7 – $10 USD per hour paid via Wise

• Hours: 8am-1pm EST M-F (remaining hours are flexible and typically beneficial to be done during China working hours)

• Paid time off: 10 days per year (1st year). Increases through tenure.

• Reports to: CEO



How to apply

Send your resume and a short note about a supply chain problem you solved — ideally one where you cut costs or sped something up. Please include "Supply Chain Manager" in the subject line.

This is great if you want to get exposed to and experience lots of technology, but it can be tough if you have a hard time learning technology. Secret Message - When you apply, you'll see a box that asks if you want to add anything else. Type in PINK ELEPHANT in all capital letters exactly as we've shown it here.





Cheat Code for getting a job with us:

1) Our application comprises the majority of our recruiting process. Because of that, we suggest that you give us thoughtful responses and rich stories. We typically only interview applicants who give rich and detailed answers to our questions. If you write short responses so that you can hurry up and finish the application, you will not get interviewed.

2) Tell us stories about how your actions match your beliefs and values. For example, if I say I value health and fitness, you don't know if I'm telling you the truth or if I'm just telling you what sounds good. But, if I tell you things I've done, I can illustrate my values of health and fitness with proof. For example, I go to the gym 4 days per week, I've done 6 triathlons, including an Ironman, and I can swim 3000 meters in one hour. My examples of things I've done prove that my actions match my values system.

3) Be vulnerable and honest. We take very detailed notes during the interview process, and we conduct extensive background checks. If the stories you tell about yourself don't match what your references say, we will not hire you. We'd rather hire a C student who is honest about being a C student than someone who is a C student but tries to pass themselves off as an A student. Remember, this is an entry-level job. We're not looking for perfect. We're looking for an excellent cultural fit. 





How to Apply: Please copy the website address below, paste it into your browser’s address bar, and press Enter to complete your application.



www.stickshiftdrivingacademy [dot] com/work-opportunities/administration-agent



Important: Replace [dot] with . before pasting the address into your browser. Do not click the link.

title: AI Consultant
description:
Overview

Notion CFO & Advisors is a fractional CFO and accounting advisory firm. We are looking for an AI Consultant to help us apply modern AI tools to improve how our firm operates. This is a hands-on, internal-facing role focused on turning real-world workflows into AI-assisted systems: reducing manual work, improving consistency, and helping our team move faster.

This is not a traditional developer role and it is not a strategy role. It is a building role, for someone who has made AI a core part of how they already work and who is ready to apply that to a real business with real problems to solve. We currently use Claude Co-Work and expect it to be part of the toolkit, but we're open to the right person bringing their own tool judgment and approach.



We are an accounting and advisory firm. The problems you'll work on are practical: faster document intake and data gathering, more consistent review and reporting workflows, smarter tracking of deadlines and open items, and automations that make our accounting, tax, and administrative teams more effective.



What you'll do

• Work directly with team members to understand how work gets done across accounting, tax, and administration

• Turn messy, manual processes into structured, repeatable systems, such as automating document intake, recurring reporting, or first-draft preparation for internal review

• Build outputs like draft summaries, status trackers, checklists, templates, and reusable skills or prompts for the team

• Connect tools and platforms so information flows automatically between systems

• Follow our data-privacy and confidentiality standards when automations touch financial or personnel information, and build in human review checkpoints

• Continuously test and improve, introducing new automations on a regular cadence

This is an ongoing role. The expectation is regular, visible progress, not a one-time build.



What you need

Required

• 2 years of daily, hands-on AI use in a professional context. AI must already be central to how you work, not an occasional tool

• Hands-on experience working with Claude, including Claude Co-Work or similar AI workspace environments

• Strong systems thinking: able to take an ambiguous, real-world process and make it structured and repeatable

• Comfort experimenting without a clear roadmap and iterating quickly based on results

• Clear communication skills; you will work closely with non-technical teammates

• Care with sensitive information and attention to accuracy



Helpful but not required

• Experience with workflow automation platforms such as Zapier, Make, or n8n

• Familiarity with tools like QuickBooks, Airtable, or Google Workspace

• Background in accounting, bookkeeping, tax, or professional services



What success looks like

• Time spent on manual, repetitive tasks drops across the accounting, tax, and administrative teams

• Recurring deliverables and internal reports are prepared faster and more consistently

• Key workflows run reliably without requiring constant human intervention

• The team is empowered to maintain and extend automations independently

• New improvements ship on a regular, visible cadence



How to apply

Attach a resume and 1–2 examples of AI or automation work you've built (link to a tool you've created or a screen recording).

title: Outbound Sales & Business Development Representative
description:
About Marketing Munster



Marketing Munster is a growing U.S.-based marketing agency helping businesses with marketing, websites, advertising, CRM, automation, lead generation, and growth.



We are looking for someone who can help us create and move sales opportunities, not simply wait for leads to arrive.



This is primarily an outbound sales and business development role.



What You’ll Do



Your main responsibility is to help generate conversations, appointments, opportunities, and revenue.



This may include:



-Outbound calling and prospecting

-Following up with inbound and older leads

-Researching potential customers

-Reaching prospects through phone, email, LinkedIn, and social media

-Qualifying prospects and booking appointments

-Following up after sales conversations and proposals

-Managing leads and opportunities inside our CRM

-Identifying referral or partnership opportunities

-Helping improve outreach based on what is working



You will work with both company-provided leads and prospects you help find yourself.



**Outbound calling is a regular part of this position.**



Who We’re Looking For

We are not necessarily looking for a 10-year sales veteran, but we do want someone with real experience in sales, appointment setting, lead generation, business development, or outbound prospecting.



You should be comfortable:

* Speaking with people you have never met

* Making outbound calls

* Handling rejection

* Following up consistently

* Asking questions instead of immediately pitching

* Researching prospects

* Using a CRM

* Working toward sales goals

* Receiving coaching and improving your approach



Experience with B2B sales, agency sales, GoHighLevel, Apollo, cold email, LinkedIn prospecting, or U.S.-based prospects is a plus.



Experience with NEPQ, SPIN, Sandler, Challenger, or other consultative sales approaches is also valuable.



We can teach you our services and systems.



We do not want to have to convince you to prospect.



English & Communication

Excellent spoken English is required.



Most prospects are U.S.-based business owners, so you must be easy to understand, confident on the phone, conversational, and able to think beyond a script.



You do not need an American accent.



Growth Opportunity



Initially, the role will focus heavily on:



Prospecting → Qualification → Appointment Setting → Follow-Up → Pipeline Development



As you learn our services and demonstrate strong sales ability, you may take on more discovery calls, proposal follow-up, objection handling, and closing.



Compensation & Schedule

$4 USD/hour + uncapped commission on eligible sales.



The position will begin at approximately 30 hours per week, with hours generally ranging between 20–40 depending on business needs and performance.



You will work a consistent schedule aligned with California / Pacific Time business hours.



Outside freelance work or another job is fine as long as it does not overlap with your scheduled Marketing Munster hours.



# How to Apply



**Please do not send a traditional cover letter.**



Generic or copy-and-paste responses will not help your application.



Instead, send the following:



### 1. Voice Recording



Send a **60–90 second voice recording**.



Briefly introduce yourself and tell us about your sales experience.



Then pretend you are calling a U.S. small-business owner who has never spoken with you before.



**Show us how you would open the call.**



### 2. Your Outbound Experience



Tell us about your most recent role involving outbound sales or prospecting.



Include:



* What you were selling

* Who you contacted

* How you contacted them

* Roughly how much outreach you personally did

* What results you generated



### 3. Find One Prospect



Find **one real U.S. small business** you think could potentially be a Marketing Munster prospect.



Tell us:



* The business

* Why you selected them

* What opportunity you noticed

* How you would approach them



Keep your answers concise and specific.



We care more about real experience, communication, initiative, and sales ability than polished application language.

title: Care Specialist

We are looking to hire immediately. This job posting will only be available for the next 48 hours. All applicants must complete take home assignment by Sunday (Nov 15) 6PM Pacific Time. See here for the take home assignment:



Interviews will be scheduled for Tuesday evening Pacific Time.



We're a fast-moving healthcare operations team that handles prior authorizations (PAs) for infusion clinic. We're building a team of sharp, hungry operators to help us do it at scale.



As a Care Specialist, you'll be on the front lines — initiating PA requests, verifying insurance benefits, navigating payer portals and phone systems, and documenting cases accurately in our internal platform. You'll work directly with our team leads and report into operations leadership.



Warning: this is not an easy job. The learning curve is steep and the pace is fast— every case you touch is a patient waiting on treatment. We'll train you on the content, but we can't train work ethic, attention to detail, or the drive to push through hard problems. If you want comfortable, this isn't it. If you want growth, you’ll fit right in.



What You'll Do

Initiate prior authorization requests with insurance payers via online portals and phone calls

Accurately document case details, call notes, and outcomes in our internal case management platform

Navigate complex payer phone trees and hold times without losing steam

Identify when cases hit non-standard situations and escalate or problem-solve proactively

Follow SOPs closely while flagging gaps or process improvement opportunities

Manage a live queue of cases across multiple statuses — nothing falls through the cracks



You're a Great Fit If You Are...

Hungry and self-driven

You don't wait to be told what to do next — you find the next task

You want to grow fast and take on more responsibility over time



Obsessively detail-oriented

You catch errors others miss - wrong codes, missing fields, inconsistent info

You don't submit work you're not sure about

You understand that one mistake in a PA form can delay a patient's treatment by weeks



A fast, independent learner

You can read a new SOP and execute it correctly within a few days

You ask smart clarifying questions before going down the wrong path

You're comfortable not knowing everything on day one and excited to learn



A creative problem-solver

When a case hits an edge case, you think before you escalate

You come to your manager with a proposed solution, not just a problem

You document what happened so the next person doesn't hit the same wall



Resilient and relentless

Hold times, rejections, and ambiguous situations don't demoralize you

You stay focused through repetitive tasks without cutting corners

Requirements

Strong written and spoken English - you'll communicate with US insurance reps and clinic staff

Comfortable working US business hours (EST or PST overlap required)

Tech-comfortable — you can navigate multiple browser tabs, portals, and spreadsheets simultaneously

Reliable internet connection and a quiet work environment

What You Don't Need

A medical or clinical background — we'll teach you what you need to know about PAs and insurance. You just need to be a fast learner.

Years of experience — we care far more about how you think and how hard you work



What We Offer

Above-market starting pay — we pay more than most entry-level BPO or VA roles because we expect more

Performance bonuses — hit your targets, earn more. Hustle is rewarded directly

Formal 4-month review — we evaluate and adjust compensation fast, not on a yearly corporate clock

Solid career growth path — PA Agent ? Senior PA Agent ? Team Lead. We promote from within and we're growing very fast

Ground-floor opportunity — you're joining early. The people who build with us now are the ones who lead later

Fully Remote

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working with people, solving problems, and moving quickly. You'll manage daily staffing operations, coordinate workers and schedules, support clients, and help keep operations running smoothly.



As their first offshore operations hire, you'll have a lot of ownership and a direct impact on the overall business. You'll be trained on their systems and processes, but you'll also be expected to take initiative, make decisions, work independently, and take things and run with them.



What You'll Do

- Manage daily staffing operations, including schedules, shift fulfillment, and last-minute coverage.

- Coordinate with workers and partners to make sure staffing requests are fulfilled accurately and on time.

- Communicate with workers to coordinate shifts, answer questions, and resolve issues.

- Communicate with clients about staffing needs, schedule changes, and operational issues.

- Help onboard new workers and ensure they are ready for their assignments.

- Monitor daily operations and quickly address issues as they come up.

- Manage internal communications and make sure important information gets to the right people quickly.

- Identify operational problems and find practical ways to improve processes.

- Give feedback to the product and engineering team when something isn't working or could be improved.

- Use Claude Code, Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI tools to solve problems, improve workflows, and work more efficiently.

- Take on different responsibilities as the company grows.



What We're Looking For 

- 2+ years of experience in staffing, workforce management, or operations, ideally in a fast-paced environment.

- Experience coordinating shifts, schedules, workers, or real-time staffing needs.

- Experience working with U.S.-based clients, workers, or operations is highly preferred.

- Previous startup experience is a strong plus.

- Comfortable communicating directly with both clients and workers.

COMPANY AND OPPORTUNITY 

Boom is building the agentic operational layer for the residential real estate industry. Property managers and landlords handle significant manual, but critical work that requires intelligence and accuracy: screening applicants, chasing income documents, reviewing reports, answering prospect calls, and often get the same questions a hundred times a week. We're replacing that with software and AI agents that do the work, and a human team that makes sure it's done right.

Our products include BoomScreen (tenant screening: identity verification, income verification, credit, criminal, eviction and rental history reports) and BoomCRM (leads, listings, and AI leasing agents), alongside BoomReport, our rent reporting product. We are a growing team led by top tier investors, a second-time founder CEO, and people with experience across real estate, consulting, and AI. We ship new features every day.



We're seeking a Customer Support Specialist to join our support and operations team. This is a real customer support role -you'll be the person who figures out why an applicant's ID verification is stuck and get them to the finish line, walk a property manager through a screening template, and write up a bug ticket in Jira to help our engineers fix the issue when something is actually broken. You'll primarily be using our customer support platform, Fin (Formerly Intercom), Slack, Teams, and Google Chat, where you will support applicants, leads, and property managers with first-hand questions. In this role, you’ll have an opportunity to use AI tools and agents to improve how you support our customers, quickly and accurately, with empathy. Additionally, our chat is AI-first and escalates to humans, and part of your job is being the human who catches what the AI gets wrong. We're excited to have a work relationship where you learn from us as much as we learn from you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO 

This role is roughly half consumer support and half business customer support, plus ad-hoc project work.

Supporting consumers (Leads, applicants, renters)

Help applicants get through the application itself - identity verification retries and failed uploads, income document submissions (bank statements, paystubs, W-2s), bank and payroll linking, application status questions

Open to change - processes and product change weekly at a startup, and you have to be comfortable with that

Fast, stable, reliable internet connection, and a quiet place to take calls

Computer specs of at least an Intel i5 processor (or equivalent AMD) and 8GB RAM

Experience with Fin, Google, Teams, and Slack is a plus

title: True Crime & Bodycam YouTube Scriptwriter – Script + Editor Brief (Work From Home, Per-Script Pay)
description:
📹 Get Paid to Write Compelling True Crime & Bodycam Scripts for a Growing YouTube Channel



We are a YouTube media company producing bodycam footage, crime case, and true crime content that is viewed by hundreds of thousands of people. We are looking for an experienced scriptwriter who has real, hands-on experience writing in this specific niche.



This is not a general content writing role. We work with real case packages — including court documents, police reports, witness interviews, and hours of bodycam footage — and we need a writer who knows how to turn dense, complicated material into a gripping, well-paced YouTube script.



You will also act as an editorial director for our video editor: alongside every script, you will leave timestamped notes that tell our editor exactly what assets to put on screen and when — images, text overlays, animations, video clips, court documents, maps, and more.



If you have done this before and can prove it with samples, we want to talk.



💰 Compensation & Payment

Competitive per-script rate — confirmed after a paid sample trial

Paid trial — shortlisted applicants receive a paid test assignment before any commitment; we do not ask for unpaid samples

Per-script model — you are paid per accepted, complete delivery (script + editor brief)

Room to increase — writers who deliver consistently and accurately earn higher rates over time

Paid promptly via PayPal, Wise, or bank transfer — your preferred method

📋 What You Will Do



Script Writing:



Receive a case package per assignment — court documents, police reports, i
 timelines, interview transcripts, and bodycam/interview video footage

Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) to help you quickly organize, review, and extract key facts from large document sets — AI literacy is expected and encouraged

Write a compelling, accurate narration script (approximately 1,000–2,000 words, depending on the case) structured for YouTube: strong hook, clear narrative arc, emotionally engaging pacing, and a satisfying close

Fact-check every claim — if it is not in the case package, it does not go in the script

Write in a tone that suits the bodycam/true crime YouTube format: direct, gripping, respectful of victims, and credible



Editor Brief Writing (included with every script):



Alongside the narration script, write a timestamped editor brief that instructs our video editor on what to place on screen, and when

Asset types you will specify: bodycam clips, news footage, police report excerpts, court photos, mugshots, maps, timeline graphics, text callouts, animated transitions

Format: timestamps matched to your script lines (e.g., [0:45] — Cut to bodycam clip of officer entering hallway. Text overlay: "November 14, 2023 — 11:48 PM")

Think of yourself as the director: your editor brief is your shot list

✅ What We Are Looking For



Required:



Proven experience writing scripts for bodycam, true crime, or crime documentary YouTube content — portfolio samples are mandatory; applications without samples will not be reviewed

Ability to read and extract information from legal documents, police reports, court records, and i
 reports — you do not need to be a lawyer, but you must be comfortable reading these documents

Comfortable working with long-form video content — reviewing 30–90 minutes of bodycam or interview footage to pull key moments

Strong research instincts — able to identify what is important, what is verified, and what should not be included

Experience leaving production notes or editor briefs alongside scripts is a strong advantage

AI-literate — you actively use AI tools to process and organize large information sets efficiently

Excellent written English — clear, engaging, and error-free

Detail-oriented and accurate — in this niche, factual errors are serious

Reliable, responsive, and professional — meets deadlines and communicates clearly

Comfortable handling sensitive case content (crime, violence, victim stories) with appropriate tone and care



Nice to Have (Not Required):



Background in journalism, law, criminal justice, or documentary filmmaking

Experience with YouTube analytics — understanding of what hooks, pacing, and structures perform best

Familiar with legal terminology and court procedures (US cases primarily)

Previous experience writing for a named true crime YouTube channel (please mention in your application)



📩 How to Apply



Takes about 10–15 minutes. Applications without portfolio samples will not be reviewed.



Step 1 — Tell us who you are: Your name, location, and a short paragraph (3–5 sentences) on your background in true crime or bodycam content specifically. What channels have you written for? What types of cases?



Step 2 — Send samples: Attach or link at least 2 scripts you have written for bodycam or true crime YouTube content. We want to see real work — Google Docs links, PDFs, or Notion links are all fine. If your samples include an editor brief or production notes alongside the script, please highlight that — it is a significant plus.



Step 3 — Answer one question: A case package lands in your inbox: a 90-page police report, three interview transcripts (totalling 4 hours), and 2 hours of bodycam footage. Walk us through how you would approach this assignment from start to finish — what tools do you use, what do you read first, and how do you d
 what goes in the script?



Your answer should be 150–250 words. This tells us more about your process than any CV ever could.



Step 4 — Confirm availability: Let us know how quickly you can start and your preferred payment method.



📧 Use the subject line: True Crime Scriptwriter – [Your Name]



Shortlisted applicants receive a paid trial assignment. We review complete applications within 3–5 business days.



⚡ Apply now — we are actively reviewing applications and filling this role.



We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. We hire based on writing quality, research skills, and demonstrated experience in this specific niche.

description:
CarmaCars is a car rental company in Toronto, Canada. This is a full operations role: you keep every car, rental and field staff member on schedule, and you make sure nothing goes out the door unfinished.



WHAT YOU DO, DAY TO DAY

- Build the day's schedule and dispatch our field staff for deliveries, pickups, returns and cleaning; confirm every job is done

- Prepare the paperwork for each rental and make sure every rental agreement is complete in full before a car is handed over

- Review pickup and return photos within an hour for damage, kilometres and fuel, and pass findings to billing the same day

- Watch return times and GPS trackers; chase late returns and handle breakdowns and roadside calls

- Dispatch tow trucks when needed

- Source parts for maintenance and repairs, and book cars into the shop

- Keep each car's status accurate (on rent, cleaning, in the shop)

- Take over customer service calls and messages when needed

- Before you finish each shift, list out all the work needed for the next day, so the morning team starts with a full plan



WHAT YOU NEED

- 2+ years in operations, dispatch or logistics for a foreign client (car rental, automotive or fleet experience is a plus)

- Organized and detail-oriented: paperwork done right, photos checked properly

- Calm on the phone in an emergency; clear spoken English

- Your own computer, headset, backup internet and power

- No work for another car rental business serving Ontario



HOURS AND PAY

- Full time: 6 days a week, 10 hours a day, starting 11:00 am Toronto time (night in Manila), weekends included

- US$450 a month

- Independent contractor, 30-day paid trial



HOW WE HIRE

Apply here. Shortlisted applicants get a message from us with the next steps: a short online application (about 5 minutes), then a 10-minute video call.



OTHER OPENINGS

We are also hiring for other positions (customer service, finance and billing), including a commission-only sales position open to any of our staff who are also interested.

title: # Senior Shopify Web Designer & Developer — Strong Design Portfolio Required
description:
Hello there,



**We are looking for someone who is equally talented at beautiful website design AND Shopify development.**



We are a U.S.-based direct-to-consumer food brand looking for an experienced Shopify designer/developer who can create visually exceptional, conversion-focused e-commerce websites.



We have established brand guidelines, including colors, fonts, and visual identity. We need someone who can take those guidelines and turn them into a beautiful, modern, fully functional Shopify shopping experience.



**This is NOT a position for someone who simply installs Shopify templates and changes colors.**



We're looking for someone with outstanding design taste, strong technical skills, and a portfolio that demonstrates both.



### What You'll Be Doing



- Design beautiful, original Shopify websites and landing pages using our brand guidelines.

- Create professional designs in Figma and translate approved designs into working Shopify pages.

- Develop and customize Shopify themes, sections, templates, and functionality.

- Build high-converting homepages, product pages, collection pages, and landing pages.

- Configure shopping carts, product variants, discounts, shipping settings, and relevant integrations.

- Ensure websites are fast, mobile-responsive, and optimized for conversions.

- Implement and troubleshoot Shopify apps and integrations.

- Deliver clean, maintainable websites that we can easily update ourselves.



### Required Skills



**Design**



- Exceptional visual design skills with a strong portfolio.

- Advanced proficiency in Figma.

- Excellent understanding of typography, layout, branding, and user experience.

- Ability to create original designs rather than rely entirely on templates.

- Experience designing premium DTC/e-commerce websites.



**Development**



- Extensive hands-on Shopify development experience.

- Proficiency in Shopify Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

- Experience with Shopify Online Store 2.0 and modern theme architecture.

- Experience with custom Shopify sections, blocks, metafields, and theme customization.

- Strong understanding of Shopify carts, checkout capabilities, product setup, and integrations.

- Experience optimizing mobile performance, site speed, and SEO fundamentals.

- Ability to recommend the most appropriate modern tools and development approach for each project.



### How to Apply



**Your portfolio is the most important part of your application.**



Please answer ALL the following questions:



1. **Portfolio:** Share links to your THREE best live Shopify websites. We are particularly interested in beautifully designed DTC/e-commerce brands. Explain exactly what you personally designed and developed for each.



2. **Design vs. Development:** Did you personally handle both the visual design and Shopify development for these projects, or were other designers/developers involved?



3. **Your Process:** If we provide brand guidelines, how would you approach designing and building a new Shopify website, from the first design concept to launch?



4. **Tools & Technology:** What design tools, Shopify themes, frameworks, and development technologies do you currently use? Would you recommend customizing an existing theme or building something more bespoke, and why?



5. **Shopify Expertise:** Describe your experience with custom product pages, shopping carts, checkout settings, shipping configurations, and app integrations. Give an example of a technically challenging Shopify project you completed.



6. **Performance:** How do you ensure the websites you build are fast, mobile-friendly, easy to maintain, and optimized for conversions?



7. Availability & Project Pricing: What is your current availability, and when could you start? We prefer fixed, flat-rate project pricing rather than hourly billing. Please share your typical flat-rate fee for designing and developing a complete Shopify e-commerce website, your estimated timeline, and what's included in your price



**IMPORTANT:** Applications without live Shopify portfolio links and answers to these questions will not be considered.



We value exceptional design, reliable execution, clear communication, and attention to detail. We are interested in building an ongoing working relationship with the right person.
